title: Multi-Device QA Tester
description:
We're looking for a hands-on QA tester to test Gather the way real people use it: one person sends an invitation from their phone, other people get it by text on their phones, they respond, and everyone's screens need to show the right thing. Most of what we need tested involves several people on several devices at the same time, using real phone numbers and real text messages.



Please read before applying



Don't apply unless you have hands-on experience testing multi-user journeys across separate physical phones with real phone numbers. This role is not single-device app testing, emulator-only testing, automated-script-only testing, or testing over
. If your experience is mainly one of those, this isn't the right fit, and applications that don't show multi-device experience won't be reviewed.



You'll need at least three physical phones with active numbers that can send and receive SMS, including at least one iPhone and one Android.



About Gather



Gather helps people plan get-togethers and get the right people there. A host creates a gathering and invites guests, mostly by text message. Guests open the invitation, respond, and the host sees responses come in. Almost every feature has at least two sides, and those sides are usually on different phones, carriers and operating systems.



Why this testing is hard



• Every interaction has two (or more) ends. The host sends, the guest receives; the guest responds, the host's view updates. A bug may only show up on one side, so both sides have to be watched at the same time.

• Real text messages behave differently from phone to phone. iMessage vs. SMS vs. RCS, link previews that do or don't render, shortened links, carrier filtering, delayed or out-of-order delivery, and replies like STOP.

• Guests arrive in different states. With the app or without it, first-time or returning, link opening in the browser vs. the app, logged in or not.

• Things change after the invite goes out. A host edits the time, a guest changes their answer, an event is cancelled, reminders fire, two people respond at the same moment, someone is offline.

• The phone number is the identity. The same person on two devices, numbers in different formats, a number already tied to an account, a contact with more than one number.

• Notifications overlap. Push notifications and texts can duplicate, arrive in the wrong order, or not arrive at all.



What you'll do



• Run end-to-end journeys across at least three physical phones with real numbers, playing host and guests at once.

• Write and maintain test cases for multi-person scenarios, including what each person should see at each step.

• Capture evidence from every side: screenshots or screen recordings from each phone, with timestamps so we can line up what happened where.

• Report bugs with clear repro steps, which side it happened on, device, OS version, carrier, app/browser, and time.

• Run regression passes on each release before it goes out.

• Flag things that are confusing, not just broken: how the invite reads in a text thread, whether a guest knows what to do next, whether the host can tell who has responded.



Example scenarios you'd test



1.  Host invites three guests by phone number: an iPhone with the app, an Android without the app, and an iPhone with iMessage turned off. Does each text arrive, how does it look, does the link work, can each guest respond, and does the host's view update correctly?

2.  A guest responds yes, then changes to no. What does the host see, and are they notified?

3.  The host changes the time after invites are sent. Does every guest get the update, and does the message make sense on its own?

4.  A guest forwards the invitation text to someone who wasn't invited. What happens when that person taps the link?

5.  A guest replies directly to the text instead of tapping the link.

6.  A guest replies STOP. What happens to future messages for that guest and on the host's side?

7.  Two guests respond within seconds of each other.

8.  A guest opens the invite, goes offline, and responds later.

9.  The host invites a number that's invalid or a landline.

10.  The host cancels the gathering. What does every guest see, in the app and by text?



Must have



• 2+ years of manual QA on mobile apps, including multi-user flows tested across separate physical devices.

• At least three physical phones with active numbers that send and receive SMS (at least one iPhone and one Android).

• Experience testing text-message-based flows, and a working understanding of how iMessage, SMS and RCS differ.

• Clear, structured bug reports with evidence from every side of an interaction.

• Comfortable installing test builds (TestFlight, Android internal testing or similar).



Nice to have



• Experience testing invitation, events, social, scheduling or marketplace apps.

• Familiarity with SMS providers such as Twilio.

• Experience with a test management or issue tool (TestRail, Linear, Jira, Notion or similar).

• Access to more than one carrier.



Details



• Type: Contract, 15 hrs/week

• Location: Remote

• Rate: Based on experience

• Start: Nov 23



How to apply



Please answer these in your application. Generic applications won't be reviewed.



1.  Describe a multi-device, multi-user journey you've tested. How many phones did you use, what were you testing, and what's one bug you found that only showed up on one side?

2.  List the physical phones and active numbers you have access to today (model, OS version, carrier).

3.  Name one thing that can go wrong with a text-message invitation link that you'd never catch in an emulator.

Its products help IT teams streamline operations, improve efficiency, reduce complexity, and maintain greater control over their IT environments. 



Client's Core Values 

• Honesty: You communicate transparently and build trust through your actions. 

• Ownership: You take responsibility for outcomes and follow through on commitments. 

• Collaboration: You value diverse perspectives and work effectively across teams. 

• Improvement: You actively seek opportunities to learn, grow, and innovate. 



Location and Work Schedule

• Remote, Philippines: This is a full-time, fully remote role for candidates based in the Philippines. Working hours align with U.S. Mountain Time (MST) business hours, which is an overnight schedule in the Philippines. 



About the Role

The client's endpoint management platform is a cloud-based, agent-based product for managing Windows and macOS devices. 



Our client is seeking a Solutions Engineer to join the Solutions team, dedicated to supporting the endpoint management platform and Windows needs across the client's products. In this role, you'll help IT administrators use the platform to package, deploy, patch, and troubleshoot software across their Windows fleets. You'll also work closely with the client's product team to make sure the platform keeps pace with how Windows admins actually work. 



This is not an entry-level support job. You'll dig into Windows as it behaves in the real world: logs, packaging quirks, deployment failures and the messy edge cases that only show up in production. You'll work directly with tech-savvy customers, often fellow sysadmins like yourself. We're looking for someone with the autonomy, technical depth, and customer focus to take on sophisticated problems and drive them to resolution. 



This role provides technical support for other sysadmins and IT departments. You will: 

• Own customer issues 

• Debug deployments and inventory/scanning problems 

• Reproduce and escalate product bugs with clear technical detail 

• Improve docs and knowledge articles 

• Provide feedback to Product and Engineering based on customer reality 



Support is primarily
-based, with some live chat. From time to time we may provide outbound phone and remote support. While this is not a Sales role, you may be the first contact that trial users have with our client, so we will be looking for sysadmins who know how to treat a customer right. You will test new features, provide product feedback, reproduce bugs, and support real-world IT environments with all their quirks and inconsistencies. 



You will be solving hard problems with other people like you: system administrators with real-world experience. Most of our support is conducted via
, with some live meetings via chat or phone. 



What You'll Be Doing: 

 Support and Troubleshooting 

   • Own tickets from start to finish, from first response through technical investigation to resolution, for sysadmins managing Windows fleets across SMB, enterprise, education, MSP, and government environments. 

   • Diagnose issues involving endpoint management agents, remote desktop applications (including agent and viewer components), software package libraries, and custom deployment packages. 

   • Investigate scanning/inventory failures, application and command deployment failures, and remote access issues. 

   • Troubleshoot connectivity, authentication, credential, and environmental issues across various customer network configurations. 

 Customer Advocacy and Product Insight 

   • Capture and prioritize customer feedback and feature requests. 

   • Identify and escalate bugs or gaps to Product/Engineering with minimal handholding. 

 Documentation and Enablement 

  • Write and maintain internal docs and customer-facing help center articles. 

 Cross-Functional Coordination

   • Collaborate with Engineering, Product, and Strategy on quality and usability. 

 Proactive Improvement 

   • Stay current on Windows platform updates, patching changes, and endpoint management best practices. 

   • Improve team processes, tool usage, and customer experience workflows. 



What We’re Looking For Must Have (Required) 

• 5+ years of system administration in Windows environments. 

     • Candidates who do not meet every requirement may also be considered if they are trainable. 

• Experience with Windows OS and application deployment, patch management, and troubleshooting. 

• Experience with endpoint management tools like Intune, SCCM, Kaseya, PDQ Deploy, PDQ Connect or similar. 

• Proven ability to configure, troubleshoot, and support software deployments in messy end-user environments. 

• Working understanding of endpoint and platform security best practices. 

• Exposure to vulnerability or remediation tools (Defender, Nessus, Tenable, etc.). 

• Working written and spoken English for customer support and collaboration with U.S.-based teams. 

• Emotional intelligence: You stay calm and address problems steadily, including when customers are frustrated. 



Nice to Have (Not Required)

• Experience with scripting, e.g. PowerShell, Python, batch.

Tools We Use

Compensation

Perks and Benefits

title: Experienced Video Editor
description:
Long-Form YouTube Editor for Finance Education Channel (Documentary Style)



Type of employment:

Part Time



Job description:



About the channel



I run The Capital Vault, a US-based capital advisory that helps established business owners ($2M-$20M revenue) secure growth capital for buyouts, acquisitions, expansions, and debt restructures. I’m building a YouTube channel that explains how business financing actually works: why banks say no, how lenders read a P&L, how a $2M deal actually gets structured, and the parts of the money system nobody explains to business owners.



The audience is business owners, operators, and people who want to understand capital. The tone is an insider pulling back the curtain. Not hype, not “get rich,” not finance-bro content. Think of it as the finance channel that respects the viewer’s intelligence.



I’m looking for a long-form editor who can turn my raw talking-head recordings into polished, high-retention videos that match a specific visual style.



The video style (this is the important part)



Every video follows the same visual language. Before you apply, make sure this is a style you can execute and enjoy:



Documentary feel, not vlog feel. Think clean, cinematic, deliberate. Reference the pacing and polish of channels like Johnny Harris, Ali Abdaal’s long-form explainers, and the Hormozi-style business breakdowns. Confident cuts, no jump-cut chaos.

High contrast, dark and clean. Deep navy and black backgrounds, gold accents for emphasis. Minimal color palette. Everything looks expensive and intentional.

Numbers on screen, always. This is a finance channel, so every key figure ($2M deal, 60 days, 27-point approval gap) appears as bold on-screen text the moment I say it. Big, clean, sans-serif, animated in with subtle motion.

Charts and explainers that teach. When I explain a concept (DSCR, a capital stack, why a bank declined a file), you build a simple animated graphic that makes it click: bars rising, a flow diagram, a before-and-after comparison. Simple beats fancy. The graphic exists to make the idea land, not to show off.

Captions on everything. Clean, readable, styled to match the brand. Key phrases highlighted.

B-roll that’s relevant and original. Screen recordings, documents, my own footage, custom graphics. No generic stock footage of handshakes and skylines. If a visual doesn’t add meaning, it doesn’t go in.

Hooks that hold. The first 30 seconds are tight and visual: the claim, the number, the question, on screen fast. You understand retention curves and cut for them.

No gimmicks. No zoom-in-every-3-seconds, no meme sound effects, no over-edited energy. Calm authority. The edit should feel like the viewer is being let in on something.



If you can watch a 15-minute Johnny Harris or a Hormozi breakdown and explain why the edit holds attention, you’ll understand what I’m after.



What you’ll do



Edit 1-2 long-form videos per week (8-20 minutes final length) from raw talking-head footage I record, plus a script for each

Cut filler, tighten pacing, and structure the video so retention holds from the hook to the close

Build the on-screen text, number callouts, captions, and simple animated charts and explainers that illustrate financial concepts

Build clean intros, chapter cards, transitions, and end screens in the brand style

Source or create relevant B-roll (screen recordings, documents, graphics), never generic stock

Deliver a first cut within 48-72 hours, revisions within 24

Study my past videos and the reference channels I share, match the style, then improve on it over time

Flag anything in the footage that could be stronger (a better order, a cut that would hold attention better). I want an editor with opinions.



What I’m looking for



2+ years editing long-form YouTube content, with a portfolio of 8-20 minute videos you’ve personally cut

Strong storytelling and pacing instincts: you know how to hold attention for 15 minutes, not just 15 seconds

Clean motion graphics and text animation (simple, professional, consistent)

Comfortable turning numbers I give you into simple charts and visual explainers

Proficient in Premiere Pro or DaVinci Resolve (After Effects a plus)

Reliable, communicative, and able to work independently from a brief

Comfortable with finance and business content (no finance background required, but you take the material seriously and ask when you don’t understand a concept)

Bonus: thumbnail design, short-form clipping from long-form (Opus Clip, Vizard), or experience with educational/explainer channels



How we’ll work



Paid trial: you’ll edit one long-form video from footage and a script I provide, so we can both see if the fit is right

Clear brief and script for every video, feedback in writing, workflow in Slack

Payment every two weeks via bank transfer

Original B-roll and graphics only. No generic stock footage.

Consistent weekly volume. This is a steady role, not one-off gigs.



To apply, include



Links to 3-5 long-form YouTube videos you edited (8+ minutes). Educational, finance, business, or documentary-style content preferred.

One sentence on why the edit in your best sample holds attention

Your editing software

Your availability per week and your rate



Start your application with the words “CAPITAL VAULT” so I know you read the full post.



I’m looking for someone to grow with. If the trial goes well, this becomes a steady long-term role, with the option to expand into short-form clipping, thumbnails, and a larger content operation as the channel grows.



Wage/Salary:

$500-$900/month (part-time, based on experience and output), with growth to full-time





:





Business or Contact Name (public):

The Capital Vault



Skills (select up to 3):

Video Editing, Motion Graphics, YouTube Content Creation

title: Facebook Group Growth & Community Manager - Experienced Applicants Only
description:
#
 Group Growth & Community Manager — Experienced Applicants Only



**Location:** Philippines | Remote  

**Schedule:** Please include your availability and preferred weekly hours.  

**Compensation:** Based on demonstrated experience. Include your expected rate.



### Build communities people want to join—and stay in.



We’re looking for an experienced
 group specialist to help create, grow, and manage several niche communities for an established U.S. business.



We need someone who understands how to attract the **right members**, start meaningful conversations, build trust, and turn community interest into qualified inquiries.



This is a hands-on ownership role. You will help shape the strategy and execute it. We will provide business context, audience information, and brand guidance. **You should already know how to build and grow
 groups without step-by-step training.**



Our company and specific niches will be shared with shortlisted candidates.



### What you will own



- **Group strategy and setup:** Research audiences and competitors; recommend positioning, searchable names, descriptions, rules, membership questions, and onboarding.

- **Member growth:** Develop and execute a practical plan to attract relevant members through organic content, partnerships, cross-promotion where permitted, and other legitimate methods.

- **Content and engagement:** Create content calendars, write engaging posts, encourage member contributions, and manage discussions.

- **Daily community management:** Review join requests, respond to comments, remove spam, enforce rules, and maintain a welcoming environment.

- **Lead generation:** Create natural opportunities for interested members to inquire about our services, with clear handoffs to our team.

- **Performance reporting:** Track member growth, engagement, qualified inquiries, and what is working. Recommend improvements based on results.

- **Multiple-group management:** Build a repeatable process while giving each community a distinct purpose and voice.



### What you must bring



- Direct experience **personally growing and managing
 groups**, with evidence of results.

- Strong written English and sound judgment when interacting with members.

- Ability to distinguish meaningful community growth from inflated member counts.

- Experience creating content that generates conversations, participation, and inquiries.

- Ability to work independently, prioritize, and follow through.

- Willingness to manage the day-to-day work—not just provide strategy.



*
 Page management, posting content, or running ads alone does not meet the experience requirement.** We need demonstrated
 **group** expertise.



We do not use purchased members, fake accounts, spam invitations, unsolicited mass messages, or misleading engagement tactics.



### What success looks like



You establish a clear launch plan, build well-positioned communities, attract relevant members, and create consistent participation. Over time, the groups should generate measurable business opportunities.



We will agree on realistic targets based on starting conditions, available resources, and your recommendations.



### How to apply



Use this application subject line:



**FB Groups Expert — [Your Name]**



Please answer these **five questions in numbered order**. Specific examples matter more than a long cover letter.



**1. What is your strongest
 group growth result?**  

Provide the group’s niche, starting and ending member counts, timeframe, and your exact responsibilities. Explain whether you started it or inherited it, and separate organic growth from paid activity or an existing audience. Include advertising spend, if any.



**2. What evidence can you share?**  

Include up to two group links, screenshots of group insights, or a short case study. Tell us what you personally did and how your role can be verified. Redacted evidence is welcome if client confidentiality applies. Do not share private member information.



**3. How did your work produce value beyond member count?**  

Give one example of improved participation, qualified inquiries, appointments, or sales. Include the result and how it was tracked. If you did not track business outcomes, say so.



**4. How would you approach a new niche group starting from zero?**  

In no more than 200 words, outline your first 30 days, how you would attract the first 100 relevant members, and what information or resources you would need from us. Do not assume an advertising budget or existing audience.



**5. What is your availability and expected compensation?**  

Include your available weekly hours, current client workload, earliest start date, expected hourly or monthly rate, and availability for occasional meetings during U.S. Central business hours.



### Selection process



Shortlisted candidates will be invited to a video interview to walk through their examples and explain their decisions. A brief paid practical assignment may follow.



Please apply only if you can show relevant experience and are comfortable taking ownership. Applications that omit the screening answers or provide only general social media experience will not move forward.



**If you have built thriving
 communities and want ownership of the next ones, we’d like to hear from you.**

title: Video Team Manager & Quality Checker (E-commerce Ads)
description:
We're an e-commerce company running several online stores across Europe. All of our ads are videos made by our in-house team of video editors, and we're looking for a sharp, organised manager to lead one of our editing teams and any other adhoc tasks.



Our editors are split into two teams. You'll manage your own team of 4 editors, while our other manager runs the second team. You'll mainly work independently but also working alongside the AD analyst/product researcher to d
 on what tasks to assign next.



What you'll do:

- Plan your team's work for the next day. Our product researcher and ads analyst will tell you which products need ads and which ads need refreshing, and you d
 what gets made and in what order

- Most of the work is new ads for new products, plus fresh ads for products that are already winning

- Assign video projects to your editors and make sure every deadline is met

- Review every video before it goes live and check it for mistakes: captions, spelling, timing, cuts, music, product shots and overall quality

- Send clear revision notes to your editors and check that every fix is done properly

- Keep track of your editors' hours and overtime

- Upload and publish the finished ads (easy to learn, we'll show you how)



Captions and languages:

Our ads run across Europe, so most of our videos have captions and voiceovers in Swedish, Norwegian, Danish, Finnish, German and Dutch. You don't need to speak these languages, but you need to be very good at comparing captions against the script word for word and spotting anything that doesn't match: missing words, typos, wrong letters (å, ä, ö, ø, æ, ü), captions out of sync or cut off on screen.



This is the most important part of the role. If a mistake gets past you, it goes live in front of thousands of customers.



You should have:

- Management experience: leading a team, planning work, assigning tasks and following up

- Experience with video production or editing, so you know what a good ad looks like and can spot mistakes quickly

- A very keen eye for detail

- E-commerce or social media ads experience is a big plus

- Clear written English, your revision notes need to be easy for editors to follow

- Reliability: you show up every day, stay on top of your team and deliver on time



What we offer:

- $700/month for 4 hours a day, 7 days a week

- A raise after 2–3 months when the work is good

- Monthly bonus based on your team's performance:

  - Few or no mistakes making it into live ads

  - Deadlines met and your team delivering on time

  - Strong, consistent output from your editors

- Reliable, long-term work with flexible hours

- Room to grow into a bigger role as we scale



How to apply:

1. Start your message with "QUALITY CHECK" so we know you read this post

2. Tell us about your management experience: how many people you managed and what the work was

3. Tell us about your experience with video production or editing

4. Portfolio or examples of previous work

title: AI Ad Producer for Meta: Lighting Brand
description:
We're Stone+Lumen, a fast-growing architectural lighting brand. Our customers are homeowners in the US, Canada, the UK and Australia who want their homes to feel considered. Almost all of our growth comes from
 and Instagram ads, and we're scaling spend. That means we need far more creative than one person on our side can make.



We're looking for one person to take creative off our plate completely.



THIS IS NOT AN EDITING JOB

Most video jobs give you a script and footage. This one gives you a product, access to our ad account, and full ownership. You d
 who we're talking to, what we say, and how it looks. Then you make it, check how it performs, and make the next round better.



YOUR WEEK

- 8 new video ads (10 to 20 seconds), delivered in 9:16 and 4:5

- 4 new static ads, delivered in 1:1 and 9:16

- Ad copy (primary text and headlines) for each one

- A quick Slack update: what won, what flopped, what you're trying next



HOW YOU NEED TO THINK

Meta's Andromeda update changed the game. The algorithm now treats look-alike ads as the same ad, so 8 versions of one idea is really just 1 ad. Winning accounts feed it real variety.



So every week you'll:

- D
 which buyer personas to target (you build and own this list)

- Give each ad its own persona, angle, setting, mood or format

- Use our Meta analyst access to see what's converting, and push harder in those directions



YOU'RE A FIT IF

- You've made AI video ads featuring real products, and you can show them

- You know how to keep a product accurate in image-to-video

- You understand Meta ads beyond just making assets: testing, fatigue, Andromeda

- You have your own AI and editing tools (Kling, Nano Banana, Runway, Midjourney, CapCut, Premiere or similar)

- You have an eye for interiors and architecture

- You write clean, natural English

- You can run on your own with very little direction



WHAT YOU GET

- $600 to $800 USD per month, fixed, for the weekly output

- Work whenever you want. We judge results, not hours.

- Slack for communication, with 2 revision rounds per ad

- A real path to full-time and a lead creative role as we grow



HOW HIRING WORKS

1. Apply using the steps below

2. Shortlisted applicants complete a $25 paid test: 1 video and 1 static for one of our products

3. The best test gets the job



TO APPLY

Write "SEE THE LIGHT" at the top of your application, then answer:

1. Links to 3 AI video ads you made, with at least one featuring a real product

2. What tools do you use and pay for?

3. How has Andromeda changed the way you plan creative? (2 to 3 sentences)

4. Pitch us one ad for a modern pendant light: who it's for, the angle, and what we see on screen

5. Your monthly rate for this workload



We skip applications that don't answer all 5.

As a Retention Account Manager, you will manage an established book of approximately 60–100 dental practices. Your primary responsibility is to keep practices engaged, identify issues early, and grow the amount of work they send.

description:
At Heritage Career Institute, we are dedicated to advancing healthcare education and preparing the next generation of nursing professionals. Our commitment to academic excellence, innovative teaching methods, and hands-on learning experiences sets the foundation for our students to excel in their nursing careers. 



We are actively looking for a DEDICATED and a highly organized ADMISSIONS & STUDENT SERVICES COORDINATOR to join our team. This role plays a vital part in guiding prospective students through their academic journey—from inquiry to enrollment—and providing ongoing support throughout their stay in the institution. WE WANT SOMEONE WHO IS COMMITTED TO LEARN THE PROCESSES AND KNOWS THAT THIS ROLE REQUIRES FOCUS AND EXTREME PASSION FOR EDUCATION.



This position that requires up to 10 hours per week, depending on the management approval. Your permanent Shift will be during the Eastern Standard Time.



POSITION SUMMARY:



Position: Admissions & Student Services Coordinator

Initial Employment Status: Probationary

Reporting To: School Director

Start Date: 1 week after signing the Offer Letter

Work Schedule: Eastern Standard Time (EST) 

Rendering Hours: up to 10 hours per week (depending on the management approval)

Compensation (Monthly): 85 pesos per hour



Responsibilities of Admissions & Student Services Coordinator

The Admissions Office at Heritage Career Institute, plays an important role in the recruitment of potential enrollees to the Institution’s healthcare programs. The Admissions & Student Services Coordinator will be the primary contact for applicants, providing the necessary information about their inquiries, and assisting them with the application and enrollment process.



This Job Description will be outlined in detail for you to further understand your role.

ADMISSIONS & STUDENT SERVICES SPECIALIST

Reports to: School Director 

Collaborates with: Registrar, Clinical Coordinator, Finance Coordinator, Marketing & Communications Coordinator 

Primary Focus: Full student-journey management (inquiry → graduate → alumni) plus catalog and front-end compliance







Key Responsibilities:



Recruitment & Enrollment:

Respond to inquiries, conduct tours, and manage online application files

Coordinate open houses and information sessions with Marketing Team

Verify admission documentation (high school diploma, transcripts, test scores)

Prepare enrollment agreements and coordinate with Finance for tuition setup

Manage lead tracking and CRM system



Student Support:

Organize orientation and track attendance/satisfaction

Coordinate tutoring or academic advising referrals

Maintain student communication (announcements, policy updates)

Handle student complaints and grievances (initial contact)



Accreditation / Compliance Duties:

Maintain and annually update school catalog (dates, tuition, policies, disclosures)

Archive marketing materials and advertising samples for CIE review

Ensure admissions and enrollment forms match approved templates

Track placement data, competitor school’s tuition information, and surveys for annual reporting (employment rates, salary data)

Maintain evidence online folder for recruitment, orientation, and placement outcomes

Ensure all marketing claims are accurate and substantiated



Qualifications:

-	Bachelor’s degree in Communication, Education, Psychology, Business Administration, or a related field.

-	Has background experience in Admissions, Student services, or Customer service is required. 

-	Strong communication, interpersonal, and customer-service skills in making calls.

-	Has keen attention to detail in reviewing and verifying documents to ensure accuracy 

-	Excellent organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple tasks simultaneously.

-	Proficiency in Microsoft Office, Google Workspace, and general administrative tools. 

-	Ability to work with minimal supervision and maintain confidentiality.

-	Ability to work during AM EST hours without any conflicting schedule 

-	Must NOT engage in any other employment, consulting, or business activity (whether full-time or part-time) that may create a conflict of schedule with the Institution.

title: Sales & Business Development - Client Relations & Project Coordination
description:
Job Overview



We are looking for a highly proactive, confident, and results-driven Sales & Business Development Virtual Assistant with excellent verbal and written English communication skills. This role is primarily focused on sales, lead management, client engagement, and closing deals. The successful candidate will be responsible for communicating with prospective clients, conducting discovery calls, understanding their business requirements, presenting proposals, following up on opportunities, and helping convert qualified leads into successful sales.

Beyond sales, this role involves coordinating with internal teams, preparing sales documentation, maintaining CRM records, and ensuring a smooth transition from sales to project implementation.

We are looking for someone who is comfortable speaking with clients, leading meetings, presenting solutions, handling objections, negotiating expectations, and confidently moving sales opportunities toward closure. This is not simply a data-entry or administrative support position. We need someone who understands the sales process and can take an active role in generating and closing business opportunities.



Key Responsibilities

1. Lead Management & Sales Development

Handle inbound and outbound leads through calls,
s, and CRM platforms.

Contact, engage, qualify, and categorize prospects based on their business needs and potential fit.

Conduct discovery calls and client consultations to understand requirements, budgets, and project expectations.

Maintain accurate lead records, sales trackers, and pipeline updates.

Follow up consistently with prospects throughout the sales cycle to move opportunities toward closure.

Identify potential upselling and cross-selling opportunities.

Support improvements in sales processes and lead management workflows.

2. Client Meetings, Sales Presentations & Deal Closing

Lead or participate in client meetings, discovery calls, and proposal presentations.

Confidently communicate services, discuss project scope, and present solutions based on client requirements.

Build professional relationships and establish trust with prospective and existing clients.

Address client questions, concerns, and objections professionally.

Coordinate pricing discussions, proposal revisions, approvals, and agreements with the appropriate team members.

Follow up on proposals and pending decisions to help close deals.

Send professional meeting recaps, follow-up
s, and action plans.

3. Proposal Development & Sales Documentation

Prepare proposal presentations, one-page proposals, agreements, and supporting sales materials.

Customize proposals based on client requirements and project scope.

Coordinate revisions based on internal feedback and client requests.

Send proposals and agreements through Zoho or other approved platforms.

Track proposal status, approvals, revisions, and pending follow-ups.

4. CRM, Sales Inbox & Communication Management

Manage and monitor the company's sales inbox and incoming client inquiries.

Handle calls, missed calls, and follow-ups through RingCentral, CallRail, GoHighLevel, and other communication platforms.

Maintain accurate CRM records, call notes, client communications, and sales activity logs.

Ensure all leads and opportunities have documented next steps.

Monitor communication channels and ensure timely responses to prospective and existing clients.

5. Project Handoff & Client Coordination

Coordinate with Account Representatives, designers, developers, and other internal teams after deals are closed.

Schedule kickoff meetings and ensure a complete handoff from Sales to Project Implementation.

Coordinate project requirements, timelines, deliverables, website assets, access credentials, and client instructions.

Assist in preparing website sitemaps and wireframe materials using SlickPlan, Relume, and Figma.

Monitor early project activities and help address coordination issues or delays.

Ensure client expectations remain aligned with the approved proposal and project scope.

6. Administrative, Reporting & Team Support

Attend sales meetings, team huddles, and operational discussions.

Prepare meeting notes, sales reports, action items, and follow-up documentation.

Maintain organized records of proposals, client communications, and sales activities.

Assist with onboarding and training new sales associates when needed.

Provide limited marketing and research support using tools such as Semrush and BrightLocal.



Required Qualifications & Skills

Previous experience in Sales, Business Development, Lead Generation, Client Relations, or Sales Administration.

Proven experience communicating with clients and handling sales-related discussions.

Excellent English communication skills.

Confidence in conducting discovery calls, leading client meetings, and presenting proposals.

Ability to understand client requirements and recommend appropriate services or solutions.

Experience handling objections, managing client expectations, and following up on sales opportunities.

Strong persuasion, negotiation, and relationship-building skills.

Experience with CRM platforms, sales pipelines, and lead management.

Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail.

Ability to manage multiple prospects and sales opportunities simultaneously.

Proactive, self-motivated, accountable, and comfortable working independently.

Professional demeanor and ability to communicate confidently with clients and internal teams.



Preferred Software & Tools Experience



Experience with the following platforms is an advantage:

CRM & Sales: Zoho CRM, GoHighLevel (GHL)

Communication: RingCentral, CallRail, Slack

Meetings: Zoom

Website Planning & Design: SlickPlan, Relume, Figma

Marketing & Research: Semrush, BrightLocal

Documentation: Google Workspace, Microsoft Office



Expected Deliverables



The successful candidate will be responsible for maintaining and producing:

Update CRM records, lead trackers, and sales pipeline reports.

Discovery call notes, client requirements, and meeting summaries.

Professional proposals, presentations, agreements, and sales documents.

Client follow-up
s, call logs, and communication records.

Sales activity updates and proposal tracking reports.

Project kickoff documentation, sitemaps, and handoff checklists.

Internal meeting notes, action item trackers, and coordination reports.



What We Are Looking For



We need someone who is:

Sales-Oriented: Understands the sales cycle and knows how to move prospects toward a buying decision.

An Excellent Communicator: Confident in speaking with clients, leading meetings, presenting proposals, and handling business discussions in English.

Persuasive & Professional: Can build trust, communicate value, address objections, and negotiate expectations.

Proactive: Takes initiative in following up with prospects and identifying opportunities.

Organized: Can manage multiple leads, proposals, client meetings, and deadlines without losing track of details.

Accountable: Takes ownership of sales activities and follows through on commitments.

Client-Focused: Understands client needs and ensures a positive experience throughout the sales and onboarding process.



* Important Note to Applicants – Please Read Before Applying* 

We appreciate your interest in this opportunity. However, this position requires relevant hands-on experience in sales, business development, lead management, and client-facing communication.



Please apply only if you have the necessary experience and confidence to communicate directly with clients, conduct sales meetings, present proposals, and actively participate in closing deals.



This is not an entry-level position or a basic administrative VA role. We are specifically looking for someone with a sales-oriented mindset, excellent English communication skills, and the ability to handle client discussions professionally and independently.



We appreciate your understanding and encourage qualified applicants who are confident in their sales and communication abilities to apply.

title: Hybrid Virtual Assistant – Customer Service & Operations
description:
Geaux Elite Auto Rentals is seeking a dependable, highly organized, and proactive Hybrid Virtual Assistant to join our growing team.



This is a full-time position from Day 1 and is designed for someone who can become a strong combination of both customer service and administrative operations.



Our current team includes dedicated support in both administrative operations and customer service. This position will serve as the third VA on the team and will help bridge both sides of the operation while strengthening our weekday, evening, and Saturday coverage.



The right person must be comfortable switching between customer-facing responsibilities and behind-the-scenes administrative work based on what the business needs that day.



Compensation



Starting Rate: $3.00 USD per hour



Schedule: Approximately 40 hours per week



Probationary Period: 90 days



90-Day Performance Review: Opportunity to increase to $4.00 USD per hour based on performance



The 90-day review will consider reliability, attendance, communication, attention to detail, customer-service performance, administrative competency, ability to work independently on Saturdays, proper documentation, judgment, initiative, and overall growth within the role.



The $4.00/hour rate is performance-based and is not automatic. Strong performers who successfully develop into the full expectations of the Hybrid VA role will be considered for the increase.



What This Role Is Designed To Do



During weekday shifts, you will often work alongside or overlap with other team members.



Depending on the day, your responsibilities may lean more heavily toward:



Administrative work



Customer service



Lead follow-up



Payment monitoring



Rental operations



Documentation



Scheduling



Reservation support



Once the other VAs have completed their shifts, you may become the primary point of contact for the remainder of the day.



You must be comfortable transitioning from administrative work into customer service — or from customer service into administrative work — depending on what is happening within the business.



This role requires someone who can look at the operation, understand what needs attention, and adjust accordingly.



Customer Service Responsibilities



You may be responsible for:



Responding to current renter messages



Answering prospective renter inquiries



Following up with leads



Helping move qualified prospects toward reservations



Following up on reservation fees



Confirming upcoming pickups and returns



Sending payment reminders



Monitoring promised payments



Following up on overdue payments according to company procedures



Answering routine renter questions



Coordinating routine maintenance communication



Reviewing previous conversations before responding



Documenting customer interactions and important updates



Escalating situations when necessary



Strong communication is extremely important in this role.



You must be able to communicate professionally, clearly, confidently, and naturally with customers through both written messages and phone calls.



Administrative Responsibilities



You will also be trained to assist with important administrative functions, including:



Reviewing upcoming renter payments



Updating invoices



Updating payment records



Preparing and sending rental agreements



Preparing agreements for upcoming rentals



Reviewing renter account information



Updating renter and vehicle notes



Reviewing payment status and balances



Helping maintain accurate internal records



Monitoring upcoming renewals



Assisting with maintenance scheduling and follow-up



Reviewing handoff notes from other team members



Following up on unresolved tasks



Helping ensure information is properly documented for the next shift



You are not expected to know all of these systems immediately.



However, you are expected to learn them, become comfortable with them, and eventually be able to perform essential functions independently when another team member is unavailable.



Saturday Is a Major Part of This Position



Saturday is one of our more important operating days.



The Hybrid VA will be the primary VA working on Saturdays.



You will usually have notes and handoffs prepared by the weekday team, but you must be comfortable working independently.



Saturday responsibilities will primarily focus on customer service and active rental operations.



This may include:



Responding to renter questions



Responding to new leads



Following up with prospective renters



Monitoring payments



Confirming reservations



Monitoring pickups and returns



Reviewing unresolved items from Friday



Using renter history and account notes to understand situations



Documenting anything that needs to be addressed the following week



Escalating serious situations when appropriate



We are specifically looking for someone who can remain productive and make good routine decisions even when another VA is not immediately available.



Schedule



This position will generally be approximately 40 hours per week.



The expected schedule will primarily include:



Tuesday through Friday: Afternoon/evening coverage

Saturday: Daytime coverage



Weekday hours may occasionally fluctuate depending on business needs.



Saturday availability is required.



Because this is a hybrid role, flexibility is important.



Some weekday shifts may be more administrative.



Others may require heavier customer-service coverage.



The ability to adjust without becoming overwhelmed is essential.



What We Expect From You



We are looking for someone who:



Communicates clearly and professionally



Pays close attention to details



Reviews previous messages and account history before asking questions



Can follow established procedures



Can work without constant supervision



Is comfortable handling customers



Is comfortable making routine decisions within established guidelines



Understands when something should be escalated



Can prioritize multiple responsibilities



Documents information accurately



Follows through on tasks



Does not allow customer situations or administrative tasks to sit unresolved



Can adapt when priorities change during a shift



Is comfortable learning multiple parts of the business



Takes accountability for their work



Is dependable and punctual



Has a stable internet connection and reliable backup connection



Has a quiet and professional work environment



We value initiative.



When possible, we do not want team members to simply say:



“There is a problem. What should I do?”



We want team members to gradually develop the ability to say:



“This is the situation. I reviewed the account and our procedures. I believe the next step should be ___. Please confirm.”



Good judgment will be developed through training, but the willingness to think independently is required.



This Position May NOT Be a Good Fit If You:



Need constant supervision



Frequently miss details



Do not review previous messages before asking questions



Have difficulty communicating with customers



Are uncomfortable speaking on the phone



Avoid making routine decisions



Struggle with changing priorities



Prefer doing only administrative work



Prefer doing only customer-service work



Frequently leave tasks unfinished



Are unavailable on Saturdays



Are looking for a short-term position



Training & Growth



This position will receive structured training in both:



Customer Operations

and

Administrative Operations



You will work closely with our existing team and learn how the different parts of the business connect.



As you become more experienced, you will be expected to handle more situations independently.



We are building for long-term growth and want team members who are interested in growing with the company.



As the business continues to expand, opportunities may become available for:



Increased responsibility



Additional training



Expanded operational duties



Leadership development



Compensation growth based on performance



How To Apply



Read this section carefully. Applications that do not follow the instructions may not be considered.



Send your application by
 to:

Hybrid VA Application - Customer Service & Operations

, include the sentence:



“I read the full job post.”



Your application should include all of the following:



Your full name



Your updated resume



A short introduction explaining why you are interested in this position



Your previous experience with virtual assistance, customer service, administrative work, sales, or similar roles



Your availability Tuesday through Saturday in U.S. Central Time

A short video introduction of no more than 3 minutes



In the video, please introduce yourself and explain:

Answer the following scenario in your
:



It is Saturday afternoon. A renter's payment was due Friday. The renter messages you and says they cannot pay until Monday. No other VA is currently working. Explain the steps you would take before d
 whether the situation needs to be escalated.



Answer this second question:



You begin your weekday shift with several administrative tasks that need to be completed. Thirty minutes later, multiple new renter inquiries begin coming in at the same time. Explain how you would determine what to prioritize and how you would make sure nothing gets missed.



Important



We are looking for someone who takes instructions seriously.



Please make sure your application includes:

 subject

Your video

Incomplete applications may not be considered.

title: Graphic Design Manager (leadership experience required)
description:
Starbond is looking for an experienced Graphic Design Manager to lead our creative team, strengthen our brand standards, and improve the quality and efficiency of our design output across digital marketing, print, packaging, and e-commerce.



This is a hands-on management role requiring at least 10 years of professional graphic design experience and at least 5 years of progressively responsible creative leadership experience, including direct management of designers or creative teams. Hands-on experience creating Amazon A+ Content is required.



The successful candidate must be able to establish creative direction, develop clear visual standards, manage team performance, and personally produce high-quality design work. You should understand how visual communication supports marketing goals and know how to use AI and modern creative tools to improve production efficiency while maintaining strong creative judgment.



Mandatory Qualifications



To be considered, applicants must meet all of the following:

At least 10 years of professional graphic design experience, with substantial work supporting marketing, e-commerce, retail, or consumer-product brands.

At least 5 years of progressively responsible creative leadership experience, demonstrating increasing responsibility for team management, creative direction, and delivery.

Direct people-management experience, including assigning work, reviewing output, coaching designers, setting performance expectations, and addressing performance issues.

Hands-on experience designing Amazon A+ Content, supported by portfolio examples.

Demonstrated experience developing, implementing, and enforcing brand guidelines.

Advanced proficiency in Adobe Illustrator, Photoshop, and InDesign.

Strong command of typography, layout, composition, color theory, hierarchy, spacing, and visual storytelling.

A portfolio demonstrating digital, print, packaging, and e-commerce design, including work produced under the applicant’s creative direction.



Individual contributor experience or project coordination alone does not satisfy the leadership requirement. Applicants must clearly demonstrate responsibility for managing people and improving team performance.



Key Responsibilities



Creative Direction and Brand Management

Own Starbond’s visual direction across digital marketing, print, packaging, social media, and e-commerce.

Develop, document, maintain, and enforce comprehensive brand guidelines and visual standards.

Translate business and marketing objectives into clear, effective creative concepts.

Establish consistent standards for typography, layout, color, hierarchy, composition, spacing, and visual storytelling.

Identify weaknesses or inconsistencies in creative work and provide specific direction for improvement.

Develop foundational designs, templates, and reusable creative systems that the team can adapt efficiently across campaigns and platforms.

Explain design decisions in terms of audience, communication goals, brand consistency, and business impact.



People and Creative Team Management

Directly manage designers and oversee freelancers and other creative contributors.

Define responsibilities, assign projects, and balance workloads based on business priorities, capacity, and deadlines.

Set clear expectations for design quality, turnaround time, communication, file organization, and brand consistency.

Review creative work and provide specific, constructive, actionable feedback.

Coach team members to improve their design judgment, technical skills, and production efficiency.

Conduct regular performance discussions, identify development needs, and address recurring quality or productivity issues.

Take accountability for the team’s output, delivery commitments, and adherence to creative standards.

Collaborate with marketing leadership and other departments to clarify briefs, resolve competing priorities, and keep projects moving.



Hands-On Design and Production

Personally develop key campaign concepts, high-priority assets, templates, and foundational designs.

Create and oversee production of:

Amazon A+ Content, listing images, product infographics, and storefront graphics

Website and landing-page graphics

 marketing visuals

Social media content and advertisements

Brochures, flyers, posters, catalogs, and product inserts

Product packaging and labels

Campaign and promotional materials

Design Amazon A+ Content that communicates product benefits clearly and supports informed purchasing decisions.

Prepare accurate, production-ready files for digital and print use.

Review packaging dielines, proofs, dimensions, bleeds, color modes, resolution, and other production specifications.

Maintain organized, editable source files and clear asset-versioning practices.



Workflow, AI, and Production Efficiency

Establish workflows that improve creative quality, turnaround time, and team capacity.

Clarify briefs and approval requirements to reduce avoidable revisions.

Introduce practical uses of AI-assisted tools, automation, templates, and reusable design systems.

Guide the team in using AI for concept exploration, image creation and editing, creative variations, and repetitive production tasks.

Maintain accuracy, brand consistency, and original creative judgment when using AI-assisted materials.

Monitor quality, timeliness, revision rates, and the usefulness of completed output.

Identify production bottlenecks and implement practical improvements.

Evaluate new tools and creative-production practices for their value to the team.



Portfolio and Application Requirements:

Applicants must submit an updated resume and portfolio. Applications must clearly demonstrate both design expertise and management experience.

title: Marketing Manager
description:
About Starbond

Starbond is a growing direct-to-consumer brand focused on delivering high-quality products and an excellent customer experience. We are looking for a hands-on Marketing Manager who can turn data, customer insights, and strong execution into profitable growth.



About the Role

The Marketing Manager will own Starbond’s direct-to-consumer growth engine across paid acquisition, retention, lifecycle marketing, content, SEO, answer engine optimization (AEO), social media, conversion optimization, and agency performance. This role requires a strong command of unit economics—including customer lifetime value (LTV), customer acquisition cost (CAC), CAC payback period, gross margin, and contribution margin—and the ability to convert these metrics into sound growth decisions.



You will directly manage marketing agencies across Meta, Google, email, and AEO while leading the internal Marketing team, setting clear performance standards, and giving the CEO timely visibility into results, risks, and recommended actions.



Key Responsibilities



DTC Growth and Customer Acquisition

Develop and lead the DTC acquisition strategy across Meta Ads, Google Ads, Shopify, email, SEO, social media, Amazon alignment, and other relevant channels.

Manage marketing for profitable growth—not revenue or ROAS alone—by incorporating product margin, contribution margin, retention, and customer quality into decisions.

Establish acceptable CAC thresholds by product, customer segment, campaign, and channel, and recommend when to scale, restructure, reduce, or discontinue investment.

Align advertising, creative, landing pages, offers, product positioning, inventory availability, and operational readiness.



LTV, Retention, and Lifecycle Marketing

Maintain a clear and consistent LTV methodology using customer revenue, purchase frequency, retention, gross margin or contribution margin, and cohort data.

Analyze LTV and retention by acquisition source, product, cohort, and customer segment, and use the findings to improve channel and offer decisions.

Lead strategies that improve repeat purchase rate, purchase frequency, average order value, cross-sell, replenishment, retention, and win-back performance.

Oversee email and lifecycle marketing quality, segmentation, deliverability, revenue contribution, and customer communication accuracy.



Paid Advertising and Conversion

Oversee paid media strategy, budget pacing, campaign structure, audience strategy, creative testing, attribution, and landing-page performance.

Establish clear testing, scaling, optimization, and stop-loss rules, and require decisions to be supported by sufficient data and financial context.

Review performance at the channel, campaign, audience, creative, product, and cohort levels.

Partner with the Web Developer on Shopify priorities, site performance, conversion rate optimization, tracking, and quality assurance.



Agency and Vendor Management

Directly manage marketing agencies across Meta, Google, email, and AEO, including scopes of work, deliverables, timelines, communication standards, SLAs, KPIs, reporting, ownership, and escalation procedures.

title: DM setter/ virtual assistant
description:
My name is Peter and I am the cofounder of Fahrenheit Fat Loss. 



About Fahrenheit Fat Loss:



Fahrenheit Fat Loss is a premium online coaching company that helps busy women, especially moms between the ages of 30 and 50, lose 20 to 40 pounds and keep it off for life.



We believe most women don't need another diet. They need a system that fits their real life.



Our coaching combines customized nutrition, strength training, accountability, mindset coaching, and habit change into one simple process that helps women lose weight without giving up their families, careers, or favorite foods.



Our mission is to help women build confidence, regain control of their health, and become the strongest version of themselves, physically and mentally.



Unlike programs that rely on quick fixes or temporary motivation, The Fahrenheit Method is designed to create lasting lifestyle change so our clients only have to lose the weight once.



Our coaching is backed by a results guarantee because we're confident in the system we've built and the support we provide.



Today, Fahrenheit Fat Loss serves women across the United States through a high touch online coaching experience and has helped hundreds of women transform not only their bodies, but their confidence, energy, and quality of life.



We're building a brand that women genuinely trust. Every conversation matters. Every message matters. Every interaction should leave someone feeling understood, challenged, and inspired to become the best version of themselves.



If you're joining our team, you're not just answering DMs or scheduling calls. You're helping change lives.



***I want to be very clear about what I am looking for in a DM setter for Fahrenheit Fat Loss.***



This is not a copy and paste position, a customer service role, or a job where you simply agree with every prospect and make them feel better. Your responsibility is to create real conversations, understand what someone is struggling with, challenge their thinking when necessary, qualify them properly, and confidently move the right people toward booking a call.



You must be available every day from 9:00 AM to 1:00 PM and from 6:00 PM to 8:00 PM Eastern Time. Monday-Saturday. These are the hours when our audience is most active, so reliability and consistency during these shifts are extremely important.



You need to be fluent in written English. Your messages must sound natural, confident, intelligent, and conversational. I do not want robotic responses, awkward wording, generic scripts, or messages that sound like they were copied directly from ChatGPT.



You may use AI to help organize information, review grammar, or improve efficiency, but you cannot depend on it to have conversations for you. You need to know how to think critically, read the tone of a conversation, ask the right follow up question, handle objections, and know when to show empathy versus when someone needs to be challenged.



You will need to study me and the Fahrenheit brand closely. That means watching my content, reading my captions, listening to how I speak, understanding my personality, learning my coaching philosophy, knowing our client success stories, and understanding the women we help.



You should know who I am, what I do, where I live, what I believe in, how I coach, how I communicate, and why prospects choose Fahrenheit. The goal is for someone messaging the account to feel like they are speaking directly with me.



You must have a strong understanding of fitness, nutrition, fat loss, and the mindset required to get results. You should also live a disciplined and healthy lifestyle yourself. I want someone who genuinely represents the standards of the brand.



Your main responsibilities will include:



Responding to incoming Instagram and
 messages quickly.



Starting conversations with new followers and warm leads.



Building rapport without wasting time in endless small talk.



Learning about each prospect’s goals, struggles, urgency, and readiness for coaching.



Qualifying prospects financially and emotionally before booking them.



Moving qualified prospects toward scheduling a sales call.



Following up with leads consistently instead of allowing conversations to disappear.



Confirming appointments and helping improve call attendance.



Keeping accurate notes and updating every lead inside GoHighLevel.



Using Typeform, Instagram,
, Meta Business Suite, Google Sheets, and any other systems required for the position.



Reviewing previous conversations so prospects never have to repeat themselves.



Communicating important information to me clearly and quickly.



You will be expected to book a minimum of 3 qualified calls per week at the beginning. That is the starting standard, not the long term ceiling. As you learn the brand, the offer, and our audience, I expect that number to increase.



A qualified call means the prospect understands what the call is for, has a real problem they want help solving, is open to coaching, has shown some level of commitment, and is not simply booking because they were pressured.



Quality matters just as much as quantity. I do not want a calendar full of people who are unqualified, confused, or unlikely to show up.



The right person for this role is disciplined, organized, competitive, emotionally intelligent, trustworthy, and able to work without being constantly reminded what to do. You should take ownership of your conversations, notice when something is not working, and communicate solutions instead of waiting for instructions.



I am willing to invest time in helping the right person understand the Fahrenheit brand, but I am not looking to teach someone basic communication, work ethic, English, or how to speak with prospects. You should already be proficient in those areas.



I am looking for someone who wants to become a long term part of the company, improve their skills, produce measurable results, and grow as Fahrenheit grows.



Before moving forward, I will want to see examples of how you communicate, how you would respond to different types of prospects, how you handle objections, and how you would move a conversation toward a call without sounding scripted or aggressive.

description:

- Test the system with a pilot collection before full deployment.

- Experience managing large video and photography libraries.

- Knowledge of user permissions and secure file access.

- Strong English communication and documentation skills.

- Ability to work independently and meet project milestones.



### Preferred Experience

- Familiarity with video production workflows and common media formats.

- Previous experience building scalable asset libraries for businesses or creative agencies.

title: Content Producer & Social Media Creative Lead — Women’s Jewelry Brand (KAEN)
description:
About KAEN



KAEN is a new US-based women’s jewelry brand focused on modern, elevated, and accessible jewelry.



We’re building a visually driven e-commerce brand where content is a major part of our growth strategy.



We’re looking for a creative, resourceful Content Producer who can take ownership of our Instagram content and help develop a consistent pipeline of high-quality video and photo content for organic social media and paid advertising.



About the Role



We are not looking for someone who simply schedules Instagram posts or makes generic Canva graphics.



We want someone who understands jewelry, fashion, visual storytelling, and what makes people stop scrolling.



You’ll be responsible for developing content ideas, organizing production, creating content yourself when possible, and coordinating with creators, videographers, and editors when needed.



Our goal is to build a repeatable content production system that consistently produces beautiful, engaging content for Instagram Reels, TikTok, and Meta advertising.



Key Responsibilities



1. Creative Research & Content Strategy



* Research successful jewelry, fashion, and lifestyle brands.

* Identify emerging Instagram and TikTok content trends.

* Develop creative concepts for organic posts and paid ads.

* Build a library of visual references and inspiration.

* Plan weekly content calendars and production schedules.

* Maintain a consistent, elevated brand aesthetic.



2. Content Creation & Filming



* Create short-form jewelry videos, including product close-ups, styling, unboxing, and lifestyle content.

* Film content yourself when appropriate, using jewelry samples provided by the company.

* Coordinate additional creators or models when needed.

* Develop shot lists and clear filming instructions.

* Ensure content looks polished, modern, and visually appealing.

* Produce content suitable for Instagram Reels, TikTok, and Meta ads.



3. Creative Production Management



* Find and coordinate freelance creators, videographers, and editors.

* Brief creators on exactly what to film.

* Manage content deadlines and deliverables.

* Review footage and request revisions.

* Organize raw footage, edited videos, and final assets.

* Maintain a consistent weekly production pipeline.



4. Instagram Content Management



* Manage KAEN’s Instagram content calendar.

* Prepare Reels, carousels, product photography, and captions.

* Schedule and publish approved content.

* Monitor engagement and identify successful content formats.

* Continuously develop new creative ideas.



5. Paid Advertising Creative



* Develop video and static ad concepts for Meta advertising.

* Work with our advertising manager to understand which creatives perform best.

* Produce variations of successful concepts.

* Test different visual approaches, product presentations, and creative hooks.

* Help scale the volume of high-quality advertising content over time.



What We’re Looking For



* Experience creating content for jewelry, fashion, beauty, or lifestyle brands.

* Strong visual taste and understanding of premium e-commerce aesthetics.

* Experience filming short-form videos using an iPhone or camera.

* Understanding of Instagram Reels, TikTok, and Meta advertising.

* Ability to edit videos using CapCut, Premiere Pro, or similar software.

* Experience coordinating content creators or freelance editors.

* Strong organizational and project management skills.

* Comfortable using AI tools to improve creative workflows.

* Able to work independently and take ownership of content production.

* Excellent written English and communication skills.



Experience producing content for DTC e-commerce brands is highly preferred.



Creative Direction



We’re building a jewelry brand with a clean, modern, elevated aesthetic.



We prefer:



* Beautiful product close-ups and jewelry details.

* Natural lighting and sophisticated styling.

* Hands, necklines, ears, and lifestyle jewelry shots.

* Short, visually engaging videos.

* Minimal, tasteful editing.

* Content that feels organic rather than overly promotional.



We are not looking for generic dropshipping ads, aggressive sales pitches, or constant talking-head videos.



Initial Goals



During the first month, we’d like to establish a reliable content production workflow and work toward:



* 12–20 Instagram Reels / short-form videos.

* 10–15 static images or carousel assets.

* A consistent Instagram posting schedule.

* A library of creative concepts and references.

* A repeatable process for developing new advertising creatives.



These are initial targets, not rigid quotas. Production volume will depend on available footage, product samples, and any additional creator or editing budget.



How to Apply



Please answer the following questions:



1. Share 3–5 examples of Instagram Reels, TikToks, or advertisements you personally created or produced. Explain your role in each.



2. Have you worked with jewelry, fashion, beauty, or other visually driven e-commerce brands? Please share examples.



3. Are you comfortable filming jewelry content yourself if we ship you physical samples? What filming equipment do you currently have?



4. Have you managed other content creators, videographers, or editors? Describe your experience.



5. Imagine you’re launching a new women’s jewelry brand with limited existing content. How would you build its Instagram content and paid advertising creative pipeline during the first 30 days?



6. What is your hourly rate, and how many hours per week are you available?



Please include a link to your portfolio.



Applications without relevant creative examples will not be considered.

We've served 350+ clinics across 26 US states with Meta advertising, landing pages, and marketing automation. Our mission is to help healthcare providers reach more of the people who need them.

You own the technical side of our client accounts, from "contract signed" to "campaigns ready to launch," and you keep everything running after launch.



You'll be the friendly, patient expert who gets on Zoom with clinic owners (most are not tech-savvy) and walks them through granting Meta Business Manager access, white-glove style. Then you'll build their CRM, calendars, automations, and data connections so their marketing runs smoothly.



You'll manage the tech for a portfolio of 40–50 active clients and run new-client onboarding calls every week. Expect about 30% live client calls, 60% building systems, and 10% troubleshooting.



WHAT YOU'LL DO



- Lead white-glove Zoom onboarding calls with new clients to set up Meta Business Manager, ad account, page, and pixel/dataset permissions, explained patiently and without jargon

- Build and configure GoHighLevel sub-accounts from our snapshots: workflows, pipelines, calendars, phone/email setup, and custom fields

- Own client data: set up and maintain GHL to Google Sheets syncs and keep data accurate and reconciled across systems

- Verify every new account against our launch-readiness checklist before handing it to the account team

- Own the tech request queue for your 40–50 clients: broken workflows, calendar issues, and integration failures

 -Keep our onboarding SOPs current as Meta and GHL change



WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE (HOW YOU'RE MEASURED)



- New clients fully onboarded and launch-ready within 3 business days of contract signing

- 100% of accounts pass the launch-readiness checklist on first review

- Tech requests acknowledged within [2] business hours and resolved within [1] business days

- Client data sheets accurate and reconciled weekly

- Clients leave onboarding calls feeling taken care of (tracked by post-call rating)



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR



- Fluent, confident spoken English. You'll be on camera with US business owners every week.

- 1+ year of hands-on GoHighLevel experience (sub-account builds, workflows, calendars)

- Solid Zapier experience. n8n is a major plus, and we'll train the right person.

- Working knowledge of Meta Business Manager: Business Portfolios, ad accounts, pages, pixels/datasets, and partner access

- Strong Google Sheets skills and disciplined data hygiene

- A calm, patient manner with non-technical people. You make clients feel looked after, never talked down to.

- Process-driven: you follow checklists, update SOPs, and document as you go

- Comfortable working a consistent night shift

- Fast, reliable internet (minimum 25 Mbps download / 10 Mbps upload), a quality webcam and mic, and a quiet workspace

- Backup power (UPS, inverter, or generator) and backup internet (second ISP, LTE, or pocket WiFi) so brownouts and outages don't interrupt client calls



NICE TO HAVE



- Marketing agency experience serving US small businesses

- Familiarity with healthcare or clinics

- API-level troubleshooting (webhooks, JSON, HTTP requests in n8n)

- Twilio/LC Phone, Stripe, or Google Workspace admin experience



HOW WE WORK



These values aren't posters on a wall. We hire, review, and promote by them.



Take Initiative. If you see a problem, you own it. You don't wait for permission.

Solutions Not Problems. Before escalating, you bring 1 problem, 3 possible solutions, and 1 recommendation.

1% Better Every Day. Every process and every person keeps improving.

Follow through on promises. If you say you'll do it, it gets done.



COMPENSATION & STRUCTURE



- Independent contractor, full-time (~40 hrs/week), paid monthly in USD
