title: YouTube Video Editor (Long-form & Shorts)
description:
You'll be building a YouTube channel for a B2B founder, and we need an editor who does more than cut footage. You'll turn raw recordings into sharp, high-retention videos and play an active part in growing the channel: packaging, hooks, formats and iterating on what the data shows.



The editing direction is clear: the retention and clarity of Alex Hormozi, with the production value of Iman Gadzhi. If you know both styles well and can switch between them, or blend them, keep reading.



The style we're after

Alex Hormozi: retention-first, value-dense

• Tight jump cuts with dead air, breaths and filler removed

• A pattern interrupt every few seconds: punch-in zooms, angle changes, on-screen text, graphics

• Bold, animated word-by-word captions with key words highlighted

• Sound effects on every beat (whooshes, pops, hits) to drive energy

• On-screen frameworks, lists and visuals that reinforce the point being made

• Hooks that state the payoff in the first 5 seconds



Iman Gadzhi: cinematic, premium, story-driven

• Cinematic colour grading and a consistent premium look

• High-quality b-roll, shallow depth of field, smooth camera movement

• Speed ramps, match cuts and clean transitions

• Music-driven pacing and layered sound design (ambience, risers, drops)

• Documentary and vlog-style storytelling with a clear narrative arc

• Minimal, elegant typography and motion graphics

Our blend: Hormozi pacing and captions for talking-head and educational content, Gadzhi visuals and storytelling for intros, b-roll sequences, vlogs and brand moments. Shorts lean Hormozi; long-form uses both.



What you'll do

• Edit long-form videos and short-form clips (Shorts, Reels, TikTok): cuts, pacing, captions, b-roll, colour, sound design

• Repurpose long-form into multiple shorts with strong standalone hooks

• Design thumbnails and co-write titles that earn clicks

• Suggest hooks, structure and formats that improve retention

• Build and maintain a reusable editing kit: caption styles, SFX library, LUTs, templates, motion graphics presets

• Track performance in YouTube Studio (CTR, average view duration, retention graphs) and iterate based on what the data shows

• Bring ideas: video concepts, format tests and references from what works in the niche



What we're looking for

• Proven editing experience with a portfolio or channel examples, ideally including Hormozi- or Gadzhi-style work

• A strong sense of pacing, storytelling and retention. You know why viewers drop off and how to stop it

• Familiarity with YouTube growth mechanics: CTR, watch time, retention, packaging

• Fluency in Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve or Final Cut Pro, plus After Effects or similar for motion

• Confident with colour grading and audio cleanup

• Self-directed, reliable with deadlines and comfortable owning outcomes, not just tasks

• Clear written English for async communication



Bonus points

• Motion graphics and thumbnail design skills (Photoshop, Figma or similar)

• Experience growing a channel from early stage to established

• Experience editing B2B, business or educational content

• Basic scripting or hook-writing skills



What success looks like in 90 days

• A consistent, recognisable visual style across long-form, shorts and thumbnails

• A repeatable editing workflow with fast, predictable turnaround

• Measurable improvement in CTR and average view duration versus our baseline

• At least a few format or packaging tests run, with clear learnings



How to apply

Send us:

1. Your portfolio or showreel

2. Two or three videos you edited, ideally with view, CTR or retention stats

3. One example in the Hormozi or Gadzhi style (or both), with a short note on the choices you made

4. Your availability, expected weekly volume and rate

Shortlisted candidates will complete a short, paid test edit on our own footage.

title: Senior IT Project Manager (MSP) | 8+ Years IT | $20-$25/hr

- Own cutover and rollback planning, testing, technical documentation, acceptance, and operational handoff to the help desk.

Your work history should show your engineering, support, administration, leadership, and project responsibilities. MSP or other client-facing IT services experience is especially relevant.

- Strong experience across relevant infrastructure domains such as Windows Server and AD/Entra identity, Microsoft 365/Azure, networks and firewalls, virtualization/storage, backup/disaster recovery, and enterprise voice. Equivalent vendor experience is accepted; every product is not required.

- Consistent organization and follow-through across multiple clients and a distributed team.

Substantial engineering or advanced technical-delivery experience, combined with proven infrastructure project delivery, is expected. PMP, ITIL, and relevant Microsoft, networking, security, or virtualization credentials support demonstrated experience; they do not replace it.



How to apply



Please apply through OnlineJobs.ph with:



1. Your resume with month/year dates for your IT roles, showing at least 8 years of overall relevant IT experience. Highlight your project-delivery responsibilities separately. Count overlapping roles once; eight years exclusively in project management is not required.

For each, name the infrastructure involved, your personal design/configuration/troubleshooting actions, the cutover and rollback approach, validation, scope, timeline, budget or resource hours, and result. Separate what you personally did from work done by other engineers. Please leave out confidential client information.

3. Your experience with ConnectWise or other project management and PSA tools.

title: Experienced U.S. Tax Preparer / Senior Tax Accountant
description:
Company: Ensign Partners

Location: Philippines, Remote

Job Type: Full-time, long-term

Compensation: $12–$15 USD per hour - negotiable based on experience. 

Schedule: Full-time U.S. Arizona business hours



ABOUT ENSIGN PARTNERS



Ensign Partners is an integrated professional services firm that brings legal, tax, financial, insurance, and business advisory services together under one team.



Our goal is not simply to complete individual tasks. We work together to help business owners organize their companies, make better decisions, protect what they have built, and confidently move their businesses forward.



We are building a team of dependable professionals who take ownership, communicate clearly, execute consistently, and care about the people they serve.



ABOUT THE ROLE



We are looking for an experienced U.S. Tax Preparer / Senior Tax Accountant based in the Philippines to join our growing Tax team.



This is a U.S. tax preparation position, NOT a bookkeeping position.



The ideal candidate has significant, hands-on experience preparing U.S. federal and state income tax returns for individuals and businesses, including Forms 1040, 1065, 1120, and 1120-S.



You must have actual experience preparing returns using professional U.S. tax software, preferably Intuit ProConnect Tax, and understand U.S. tax compliance, deductions, adjustments, supporting schedules, and filing requirements.



You will work directly with Ensign's U.S.-based Tax team to prepare accurate returns, identify issues, manage deadlines, and move completed work through review and authorized filing.



We are looking for someone who can independently prepare tax returns, not someone who needs to be trained in U.S. taxation from the beginning.



WHAT YOU WILL DO



U.S. TAX RETURN PREPARATION



Independently prepare U.S. individual income tax returns (Form 1040), including relevant schedules and supporting documentation.



Prepare U.S. business tax returns, including Forms 1065, 1120, and 1120-S.



Prepare applicable state income tax returns, extensions, and amended returns.



Review client financial statements, prior-year returns, and supporting records to identify missing information, discrepancies, and tax adjustments.



Apply U.S. federal and state tax rules to accurately calculate taxable income, deductions, credits, and other tax items.



Prepare complete tax workpapers and documentation for senior review.



Identify potential tax compliance issues and opportunities for tax planning.



Coordinate with the U.S. Tax team to resolve review comments and finalize returns for authorized filing.



TAX TEAM SUPPORT



Manage multiple tax returns and assignments while meeting internal deadlines and filing requirements.



Communicate missing information, outstanding questions, and tax issues to the appropriate team members.



Assist with tax research, estimated tax calculations, and other tax compliance projects.



Maintain accurate client records, tax documentation, and task updates.



Help improve tax preparation processes, checklists, and quality standards.



Collaborate with Ensign's Tax and advisory professionals to support accurate, timely client service.



CLIENT COMMUNICATION



Communicate professionally with U.S.-based clients and internal team members through
 and virtual meetings.



Request missing tax documents, financial information, and clarification when needed.



Explain tax-related questions clearly and professionally.



Provide consistent updates on assigned work and outstanding items.



Demonstrate accountability, accuracy, confidentiality, and dependable follow-through.



REQUIRED EXPERIENCE AND SKILLS



Active Philippine CPA license or U.S. CPA credential preferred, with substantial U.S. tax preparation experience required.



5+ years of professional tax preparation experience, including at least 3 years preparing U.S. federal income tax returns.



Demonstrated hands-on experience preparing Forms 1040, 1065, 1120, and 1120-S.



Experience preparing U.S. federal and state tax returns using professional tax software.



Intuit ProConnect Tax experience strongly preferred.



Experience preparing complete returns for review, rather than only collecting documents or supporting bookkeeping.



Strong knowledge of U.S. federal income tax concepts, business entity taxation, deductions, depreciation, and tax adjustments.



Ability to read financial statements, review trial balances, and prepare tax-related adjusting entries.



Experience working with U.S.-based accounting or tax firms strongly preferred.



Strong Excel skills and familiarity with QuickBooks Online financial reports.



Excellent written and spoken English.



Ability to work independently, maintain confidentiality, and meet deadlines.



IMPORTANT: We are specifically seeking applicants with proven U.S. tax return preparation experience. General accounting, Philippine tax compliance, and bookkeeping experience alone will not qualify for this position.



OUR CORE VALUES



ENJOY THE JOURNEY

We work hard, maintain perspective, support one another, and bring a positive attitude to the work we do.



MOVE THE CHEESE

We adapt when circumstances change. We do not remain stuck in old processes simply because they are familiar.



BE YOUR BEST

We prepare, improve, accept feedback, and consistently work to become better professionals and teammates.



AIM TO WIN

We approach our work with purpose. We set meaningful goals, solve problems, and focus on producing strong results.



RAISE THE BAR

We do not settle for average work. We look for ways to improve our quality, service, systems, and execution.



KEEP YOUR WORD

We do what we say we will do. When circumstances change, we communicate early and take responsibility.



STRONGER AS ONE

We share information, help our teammates, and make decisions based on what is best for the client and the entire company.



WHY JOIN ENSIGN PARTNERS?



Full-time, long-term opportunity.



Work with a growing U.S.-based professional services company.



Be part of a collaborative team.



Work directly with experienced business, legal, insurance, financial, and tax professionals.



Opportunity to grow as Ensign Partners grows.



Make a meaningful contribution to our clients and our team.



HOW TO APPLY



Please follow these instructions carefully.



Do NOT
 us directly. Applicants who
 outside this job posting will be disqualified.

A brief introduction explaining why you are interested in this position.

How many years of hands-on U.S. tax return preparation experience do you have?

Which U.S. tax forms have you personally prepared? Specify Forms 1040, 1065, 1120, and 1120-S.



Compensation is $12–$15 USD per hour, depending on demonstrated experience and qualifications. Our main goal is we get the right candidates.

title: Loan Deal Coordinator – US Small Business Funding (MCA, Term, Equipment) – Full-Time, Long-Term
description:
# Loan Deal Coordinator – US Small Business Funding (MCA, Term, Equipment) – Full-Time, Long-Term



**Pay:** $900–$1,400 per month, based on experience. **Hours:** US Eastern business hours, Monday to Friday, 8:00am–5:00pm ET (about 9:00pm–6:00am Philippine time). **Location:** Philippines preferred. **Start:** Monday, November 23.



**About 
.** We help US small businesses get funding. That includes working capital, term loans, lines of credit, equipment financing and revenue-based financing. We work with a panel of 25 to 40 funders.



**The role.** You own every deal from signed application to funded account. We aim to fund deals in under 48 hours from the signed application. You will report to our Head of Borrower Acquisition. Our capital desk d
 which funder and program each deal goes to, and you follow its routing instructions exactly.



**What you will do**



- **Package assembly.** Build complete submission packages. Each one needs the signed application, 3–6 months of business bank statements, bank verification through Plaid or DocuBank, owner government ID, business documents, premises documentation such as a lease, and personal and business credit.

- **Pre-submission checks.** Run a UCC and lien search. Scan the bank statements for existing advances and stacking: how many positions there are, how much is debited each day or week, and the total holdback burden. Verify the entity with state records, and check that the phone number and address make sense.

- **Submission.** Submit to the funder and program the capital desk specifies, exactly as specified. Log every submission the same day.

- **Conditions.** Chase open conditions by phone and
 with funder underwriters and with the business owner. Re-submit the same day a condition clears.

- **Funding confirmation.** Get written confirmation of funding. Check the deposit against the term sheet and log the funding event.

- **Aging report.** Keep a live report of every open deal. It shows the stage, the blocker, who owns the blocker and how long the deal has been in that stage.



**Must have**



- 2+ years as a loan processor or funding coordinator for a US merchant cash advance (MCA), equipment finance or small-business lending company.

- Hands-on bank statement analysis: deposits, NSFs, negative days, average daily balance and existing positions.

- Working knowledge of factor rates, holdbacks, payback amounts and UCC searches.

- Experience with e-sign workflows such as DocuSign or PandaDoc.

- Clear, neutral spoken English on the phone with US underwriters and business owners.

- Reliable internet with a backup connection, a quiet workspace, and the ability to work US Eastern hours.



**How we hire.** There are five steps. First, short screening questions. Second, a 15-minute recorded phone interview, where we assess spoken English. Third, a paid 2-hour work sample. Fourth, a live video interview with an ID check. Fifth, two references from US-facing employers. We plan to make an offer by November 20 for a November 23 start.



**No-proxy policy.** The person we interview must be the person who does the work. You may not subcontract, share your account, or have someone else take calls. We verify identity on video and check again from time to time. Breaking this policy ends the contract immediately.



**To apply, answer the screening questions and start your cover letter with the word FUNDED.**



**Screening questions**



1. Which US lending or MCA companies have you processed deals for? Give your role and how long you worked there.

2. A merchant's statements show three daily ACH debits from different funders. What does that tell you, and what do you check next?

3. What goes into a complete submission package for a $50,000 working capital deal?

4. What is a UCC-1 filing, and how do you search for one?

5. Can you work 8:00am–5:00pm US Eastern, Monday to Friday, starting Monday, November 23?

title: Amazon Operations Manager - Private Label Brand (US & Canada), AI-Forward Role
description:
ABOUT US



We are a Canadian private-label brand. We sell on Amazon in the US and Canada, and we also sell direct to universities and medical training programs across North America. Around 15 product lines. Small team: a PPC manager, a few VAs, and the owner.



We are at an interesting moment. We are rebuilding this role from the ground up and automating the repetitive half of it with AI agents, right now, before anyone starts. You would not be inheriting a mess. You would be stepping into a documented system and helping decide what gets built next.



THE ROLE



Full-time, 35 hours a week.



The repetitive half of this job is being automated as you read this: shipment tracking, delivery-window monitoring, freight quote generation, supplier chasing, listing suppression alerts. You are not here to produce reports. You are here to close the things those systems surface, and then to grow the business.



- Inbound logistics. Build FBA and AWD shipment plans. Request freight quotes, check them against our cost-per-unit history, and recommend. Keep every shipment moving and every delivery window current. Handle customs documentation.

- Suppliers. Place orders with our factories in China and Hong Kong, hold them to production dates, check invoices against what was agreed, manage print files and samples.

- Account health. Work the suppressions and listing issues our monitoring flags. File and escalate Amazon cases, including past first-line support. Keep compliance documentation current: CPC certificates, safety documents, HTS codes.

- Inventory. Days of cover by ASIN and by marketplace, reorder recommendations, Q4 and Chinese New Year build-ahead, FBA capacity and restock limits.

- Listings and pricing. Copy and title upkeep, coupons and sale prices, Buy Box monitoring, competitor scanning.

- Marketing materials. Listing images, infographics and promotional pieces, produced with AI tools and briefed out to a designer when the job genuinely needs one.

- Growth, and this is the half that matters most. Two of our product lines have declined significantly and we want them back. Per-ASIN analysis, ranking and listing recovery, pricing work. Specific trackable actions, worked one at a time, with results measured.

- AI tooling. You will inherit the automation we are building, use it every day, tell us where it is wrong, and help decide what gets built next.



WHAT THIS ROLE IS NOT



It is not a reporting job. We have had plenty of status updates that went nowhere. Every red item comes with a recommendation, every recommendation gets a decision, and every decision gets acted on and closed. If you like finishing things, you will like this role.



WHO SUPPLIES THE JUDGMENT



Increasingly, you do. We will give you written procedures, an approval matrix with real dollar limits so you can spend without asking, and a working automation layer. What we will not do is hand you a task list every morning.



The thing we care most about is whether you close the loop. Verify after you push a change. Check a number against history before you forward it. Tell the person affected what was decided. Build a reminder for anything that happens every year. We would rather hire someone with one year of experience and that instinct than five years without it.



WHAT YOU MUST HAVE



- At least one year of hands-on Amazon Seller Central work, in-house or at an agency. We are not expecting you to have seen everything. We are expecting you to already know what a flat file is, how a shipment plan works and what a suppressed listing looks like, so the only genuinely new thing is our products.

- Real AI fluency, and enthusiasm for it. You already use Claude, ChatGPT or similar in your actual work. You are curious about agents and automation, you have tried building something, and you want to get much better at it. A large part of this role is working alongside automation we are building now and telling us where it should go next. If AI is something you have read about but never used in anger, this is not the role.

- The judgment to distrust AI output. This matters as much as the point above. We were once burned by an AI inventing freight fees that did not exist, and it cost us a week on a time-critical shipment. We want someone who leans on these tools hard and still checks them.

- Basic design ability, AI-assisted. You do not need to be a graphic designer. You do need real experience producing marketing materials with AI tools: listing images, infographics, promotional graphics. Just as important is knowing when something is good enough to publish and when it should go to a professional.

- Business-fluent written English. This role writes Amazon appeals and instructions to Chinese suppliers. Both have to be unambiguous.

- Self-direction. You will work four hours a day before anyone in Toronto is awake. Nobody is watching you work, so you need to be the kind of person who picks the next most important thing without being told.

- Comfort with spreadsheets. Enough to hold a cost model in your head and notice when a number is wrong.

- Genuine interest in online business. Ecommerce, marketplaces, brands, how they grow. Not just a job in a browser.



STRONG PLUS



- A marketing degree or marketing studies. Underneath all the logistics, this is a marketing business: listings, ranking, pricing, positioning, conversion. Formal marketing grounding helps you understand why the operational work exists.

- Canva or light Photoshop beyond the AI tools, and print-file literacy.

- Experience briefing and quoting an outside designer.



WHAT WE ARE NOT LOOKING FOR



Years of agency seniority, or product research and arbitrage experience presented as private-label work. We would rather train the right person than rent a long CV. If you are early in your career, ambitious and genuinely interested in this, you are exactly who this posting is for.



HOURS AND SCHEDULE



Full-time, 35 hours a week, on a tapered schedule: a strong start to the week and short Fridays. Same start time every day, finishing earlier as the week goes on. All times Philippine time.



Monday: 4:00pm to 12:00am (8 hours)

Tuesday: 4:00pm to 12:00am (8 hours)

Wednesday: 4:00pm to 11:00pm (7 hours)

Thursday: 4:00pm to 10:00pm (6 hours)

Friday: 4:00pm to 10:00pm (6 hours)



This is an evening shift and we want to be completely clear about that before you apply. The reason is overlap. The owner is in Toronto, so these hours mean you work four hours on your own each day and then have real live time together: four hours on Monday and Tuesday, tapering through the week. You open each day with what happened and what needs deciding, rather than waiting to be told what to do.



There is no night differential. The rate reflects the schedule.



The schedule is anchored to Toronto time, so the Philippine clock shifts one hour later between November and March when North America changes clocks. Monday and Tuesday become 5:00pm to 1:00am in that period.



If you need to shift hours occasionally, that is fine. If you lose power or need time off, tell us early. We would much rather know.



Please do not apply if an evening schedule does not genuinely suit you. It is a real constraint, we have had it go wrong before, and a candidate who takes it reluctantly ends up worse off than one who never applied.



HOW WE TRACK TIME



We use DeskTime for hourly time tracking, which takes periodic screenshots. We are telling you up front because some people are not comfortable with it, and that is a fair position. Better to know now than after you start.



To be clear about what it is for: it counts hours for payroll. It is not how your work gets judged. Reviews are based on what you closed and what moved.



Screenshot tracking comes off after 90 days once your hours are established. Time logging stays, because that is how you get paid.



COMPENSATION



USD 7.00 per hour for 35 hours a week, paid twice monthly by Wise against logged hours. That is roughly USD 1,060 per month, plus 13th-month pay, so about USD 1,150 per month all in.



On top of that, one bonus, and only one: 10% of the growth in monthly profit against the same period a year earlier.



That is the whole incentive structure. We deliberately did not build a dozen small commissions, because a bonus you have to argue about is worse than no bonus. One number, taken from the P&L, paid quarterly.



How it works in practice. If the business was averaging USD 10,000 a month in profit over the year before you joined, and it runs at USD 12,000, that is USD 2,000 of growth and USD 200 a month to you, so USD 600 a quarter. It is measured on a three-month rolling average against the matching three months of your baseline year, so one early shipment or one late freight invoice cannot distort it.



It counts growth from both directions. Sell more and it goes up. Find a cheaper freight lane, cut a fee, fix a margin, and it goes up the same way. We want someone who actually reads the numbers, not someone who only thinks about the top line.



We will show you the profit figure. You cannot be accountable for a number you are not allowed to see.



Being straight with you about the timing. Two of our product lines have declined this year. Your baseline is the twelve months immediately before you start, so you are not being measured against someone else's better year, but the bonus will still likely pay nothing for your first few months while you find your feet. The near-term upside is the 90-day review and raise. The growth share is the long game, and it is uncapped.



A formal review at 90 days with a raise if it has gone well, and annually after that. We would rather grow someone into this role and keep paying them more than hire cheap and replace them every year.



WHERE THIS ROLE GOES



Be honest with yourself about whether this appeals. The rate is a starting point, not a ceiling, and the reason we are hiring at this level is that we would rather find someone early and grow them than rent seniority.



In twelve months the person in this role should be deciding freight routes without asking, running the supplier relationships directly, owning the growth plan for two or three product lines, and telling us what the automation should do next rather than waiting to be told. If that sounds like the job you want, apply. If you are looking for steady task work at a fixed scope, this will frustrate you and we would rather you knew now.



HOW TO APPLY



Do not send a generic cover letter. Send us four things:



1. The hardest Amazon problem you have personally worked on. What was broken, what you tried, what actually worked, and how long it took. If it never got solved, say so. That is a fine answer.

2. A freight quote comes back at USD 0.91 per unit. How would you know whether that is reasonable?

3. What you use AI for in your actual work, and one time it gave you something wrong that you caught.

4. A link or two to marketing materials you have made, and which tools you used.



Applications that skip question 2 or question 3 will not be read.



We may ask a shortlisted candidate to do a short paid task on a real open problem from our backlog before we commit, so you can see the work and we can see how you think.

We specialize in credit repair and business funding solutions, including merchant cash advances, and we've built our reputation on getting clients real results. We're growing fast and need a sharp, driven appointment setter to keep our closers' calendars full.



The Role

You're the first voice our leads hear. Your job is to connect with inbound and warm leads, qualify them, and book quality appointments with our closing team. If you love the phone, move fast, and get energized by hitting numbers, this seat is for you.



What You'll Do



Call, text, and message inbound and warm leads quickly, ideally within minutes of opt-in

Qualify prospects on credit profile, business revenue, time in business, and funding needs

Book qualified appointments directly onto closers' calendars

Send confirmations and reminders, and follow up on no-shows to reschedule

Keep clean, accurate notes in the CRM after every touchpoint

Hit daily activity targets and weekly booked-and-showed appointment goals

Stay on script and within compliance guidelines at all times







Requirements:

• 3+ years of experience as a Appointment setter 

• Proven ability to set appointments and communicate effectively with clients 

• Strong working knowledge of gohighlevel CRM

• Must have Great English

• Comfortable communicating with prospective clients and coordinating with team 

• Excellent written and verbal communication

title: Financial analysts
description:
Beckford & People is looking for a Financial Data Analyst to turn our operational and sales data into clear, actionable insight. What We're Looking For

title: Professional Services Delivery Engineer (Information Technology)
description:
Professional Services Delivery Engineer (Remote)



Type: Contract to start, with a path to full time as the business grows

Location: Remote, no travel. Set overlap with US Central Time.



About Us

We are an IT resilience consulting firm. We design, build, test, and improve disaster recovery for enterprise customers. Our specialty is Zerto within the HPE ecosystem, across VMware, Hyper-V, AWS, and Azure. We also build our own tools, including VPG Factory. We are a small, hands-on team, and you will work directly with the founders and with customers.



The role

This is a hands-on, post-sales delivery role. You will deploy and tune Zerto, run DR assessments and reviews, build runbooks, support failover tests, and write automation that removes manual work. We will train you on Zerto. You bring the broad infrastructure knowledge and the ability to learn fast.



What you will do

-Deploy, upgrade, and configure Zerto for VMware, Hyper-V, Azure, and AWS

-Run DR readiness assessments and customer reviews and write up findings

-Design and build protection groups, including at scale with VPG Factory

-Plan and support failover tests and live DR exercises

-Write runbooks and as-built documentation

-Troubleshoot replication, network, storage, and hypervisor issues

-Script and automate with PowerShell, Python, Bash, or Ansible, using Zerto and cloud APIs

-Support workload migrations and test our internal tools before release



Must have

-7+ years of hands-on IT infrastructure experience

-Working knowledge of VMware vSphere and Hyper-V (vCenter or SCVMM)

-Familiarity with AWS and Azure core services

-Solid networking fundamentals: VLANs, routing, DNS, firewalls, re-IP

-Windows Server and Active Directory, plus comfort with Linux

-Storage basics: SAN, NAS, iSCSI, FC, snapshots, replication

-Scripting in PowerShell, Python, or Bash

-A clear picture of how all the pieces fit together, and the ability to trace a problem across layers

-Fast learner who gets productive on new products quickly

-English at C2 (proficient) level, written and spoken

-Reliable internet and a quiet place for customer calls



Nice to have

-Zerto or another DR product (Veeam, SRM, ASR, AWS DRS, Cohesity, Rubrik)

-Using AI tools to learn, write scripts, and build automation

-Ansible or other configuration management

-Exposure to software development and QA practices (Git, issue tracking, test plans)

-Consulting or managed services experience

-VMware, Azure, or AWS certifications



What we offer

-Competitive contractor rate, paid in USD

-Path to a full time role

-Hands-on Zerto and enterprise DR training from engineers who do this work daily

-Lab access, and a mix of customer projects, automation, and tool development



Pay

-$7/hr. for non customer facing work (training, lab work, software testing, etc.)

-$25/hr. for customer facing work (Professional Services engagements)

title: Supply Chain Manager for General Fashion Dropshipping Stores
description:
Join a Fast-Growing E-commerce Team!



We run multiple fashion dropshipping Shopify stores for the US, UK and French markets, and we are still growing. Our products ship from our supplier in China. To support our growth, we are looking for a dedicated Supply Chain Manager with extensive experience in general fashion dropshipping who makes sure every order ships on time and every order problem gets solved.



What You'll Be Doing:

- Following up with our supplier agent so every order ships on time, and handling the problem orders our Parcel Panel Checker escalates to you

- Checking unfulfilled orders in Shopify every day and finding out why they did not ship

- Solving out of stock orders: finding the product through our supplier, other factories, AliExpress, Alibaba, 1688 and ServicePoints before we
 the customer

- Sending customer
s in Gorgias for order problems, using our macros and follow-up schedule

- Checking the real photos and size charts of new products, and finding a better supplier when the quality is not good enough or the cost price is too high

- Processing refunds and checking that our supplier refunded what we asked

- Asking our supplier for lower prices on best sellers and products above our maximum cost price

- Weekly stock check, weekly report decks and presenting them in our weekly team meeting



Your KPIs:

- 100% of refunds and cancellations logged and requested from our supplier on the same day

- Zero missed supplier refund requests for out of stock items

- 0 orders open longer than 8 days in Shopify

- Every follow-up
 to customers sent on time

- Weekly stock check 100% completed every Monday

- Hubstaff activity of 80% or higher



What We're Looking For:

We know exactly how this work runs, so we know exactly who will thrive in this role. You are a great fit if you have all of the following:

- Extensive experience as a Supply Chain Manager in general fashion dropshipping, working with suppliers in China. You know how it works: solving out of stock orders (other factories, similar items), quality checks on new products, refunds from the supplier and negotiating lower prices.

- Experience with Shopify admin, Gorgias, Google Sheets, 
 and Hubstaff

- Experience with sourcing on AliExpress, Alibaba, 1688 and ServicePoints

- Availability Monday to Friday from 9:00 AM to 11:00 PM Philippine time, the active hours of our supplier, and on Sunday for the weekly check. You don't work all those hours, you simply clock in and out in Hubstaff whenever there's something to handle.

- Your 
 notifications are on, so you see new messages from our supplier and the team right away, and you reply as soon as possible (our KPI: within around 15 minutes). Speed is key in supply chain. Our supplier is quick, so a quick reply from us means orders ship the same day, customers stay happy and we avoid refunds and chargebacks.

- This is your only job, so you can give it your full focus during the supplier's hours.

- You work through our daily workflow every day with one goal: every order gets shipped, every problem gets solved, and no customer waits without an answer. Your day is complete when nothing is left open without a reason.

- You join our weekly team meeting every Monday from 5:00 PM to 6:00 PM Philippine time

- Good written English



What You'll Get:

- $5 USD per hour, with room to grow 

- Performance-based bonuses

- A supportive, expanding team that helps each other succeed

- Opportunities to grow into other roles within the company

- Long-term role in a fast-growing team, with bigger stores being added



How to Apply:

We read every application personally, so we'd love to see right away that this role fits you.

1. Please start your application with this sentence, so we know you are fully aware of what the role involves, what is expected of you, and that you read the entire job post carefully:

"I am a Supply Chain Manager with extensive experience in general fashion dropshipping, I am available from 9:00 AM to 11:00 PM Philippine time with my 
 notifications on, I reply to messages as soon as possible, within around 15 minutes, I have no other job, and every day I make sure every order gets shipped, every problem gets solved and no customer waits without an answer." 

2. Then tell us how you meet each point under "What We're Looking For": which stores you worked for, which tools you used and how, and an example of an out of stock order you solved.

3. Add your resume.



This way we can see straight away that you read everything and that this role is a great match for you, and we can get back to you quickly. Applications that include the sentence and cover every point are the ones we move forward with.



Looking forward to hearing from you!

title: Payments Reconciliation Lead
description:
Payments Reconciliation Lead - Contract



Job Description

WHO WE ARE

Customer is the most valued partner for K–12 schools to build trust, strengthen community, and grow enrollment. Ranked among the best EdTech Companies in America, Customer supports more than 7,000 schools and districts worldwide with an integrated platform for websites, communications, mobile apps, enrollment, and marketing services.

Headquartered in Glastonbury, Connecticut, Customer is a global company with employees working remotely across nearly every U.S. state, as well as throughout Europe, South America, and Asia.

We believe people do their best work when they feel supported, connected, and empowered to grow. That’s why we invest in our employees through competitive benefits, professional development opportunities, and a collaborative culture built on partnership and purpose. Whether you’re looking to expand your skills, take on new challenges, or make a meaningful impact in education, Customer offers the opportunity to grow your career while helping schools thrive.

At Customer, every interaction matters — with our clients, with each other, and with the schools and families we serve. Join us and help shape stronger school communities around the world



SUMMARY

Customer gives K-12 schools and districts one connected suite for their websites, communications, enrollment and payments, used by about 7,000 districts and schools. Payments is the part of that suite that ties the others together: a family that gets a message from the school, enrolls a student and pays a fee should see one experience, and the district's finance office should see one clean set of books. We are building a reconciliation service to support our largest district clients as that suite comes together, and we are looking for a Payments Reconciliation Lead to build it and run it. You will set up the procedures, hire and train a small team, and be the person who makes sure a district's numbers tie every day. You report to the Sr. Accounting Manager and work daily with Customer Success, who own the client relationship, and with Product. This is a contract-to-hire role.



RESPONSIBILITIES

•  Runbooks: Turn each district's reconciliation workflow, from the first chargeback notice to the final tie-out against settlement, into written procedures with quality checks.

•  Team: Hire and train 5 to 10 reconciliation specialists through a staffing partner or an offshore vendor.

•  Daily Tracking: Run a daily tracker of which task, which client, who did it and who reviewed it.

•  Quality Review: Review every file before it goes out. Nothing reaches a district unchecked.

•  Client Reporting: Send a weekly status to each client's Customer Success Manager, who owns the client conversation. Make sure they walk in with the facts.

•  Chargeback Notices: Own the handoff from Operations so each district gets a complete notice with the order and transaction detail attached, instead of a screenshot in an
.

•  Line-Item Reconstruction: Locate each affected order in the Web Store portal, rebuild it at the line-item level with the account or GL code from Inventory, the payment ID, the dollar amount and the sales tax, and lay it out the same way as the district's settlement file.

•  Fix Files: Produce the ERP-ready correction file, broken into the right accounting lines with sales tax, in the district's import format (Munis, for example), and confirm it posted.

•  Settlement Tie-Out: Reconcile the individual orders and the fix-file detail back to the single aggregated chargeback deduction on the settlement statement.

•  Related Notices: Extend the same approach to delayed or unfunded transactions and to disputes and NSF returns, so districts get one daily file instead of one
 at a time.

•  Automation Input: Keep a ranked list of what is slow and which report fields would remove each step, and hand it to Product and Engineering.

•  Capacity and Cost: Track hours per client per workflow, build the capacity model for the full client list, and recommend US temps versus offshore from real error and turnaround data.

•  Performance Measures: Same-day task completion, files out by the agreed cutoff, business days from chargeback notice to ERP-ready file, disputes surfaced within one business day, fix files that tie with no rework, and automation requests accepted by engineering.



QUALIFICATIONS AND SKILLS

•  5+ years in accounting operations, treasury, payments or merchant services, with bank or settlement reconciliation as your own daily work, not something you reviewed from above.

•  2+ years leading, training or supervising a reconciliation or back-office team. Temp or offshore staff is a plus.

•  Experience writing procedures and quality checks that other people followed.

•  Working knowledge of the card dispute and chargeback process from the merchant side, including evidence deadlines.

•  Experience producing or validating ERP import files. Munis is a plus.

•  Advanced Excel: lookups, SUMIFS, pivots, large CSV cleanup.

•  Ability to explain a reconciliation break to someone who is not an accountant.

•  CPA, CMA or an accounting degree is a plus.

•  Payment processor, payment facilitator or bank operations background is a plus.

•  K-12 or public sector fund accounting is a plus.

•  Experience managing a staffing partner or an offshore vendor is a plus.

•  Experience handing a manual process to a product team to automate is a plus.

title: Payment Reconciliation Specialist
description:
SUMMARY

Customer gives K-12 schools and districts one connected suite for their websites, communications, enrollment and payments, used by about 7,000 districts and schools. As that suite comes together, our largest district clients need their payment records to tie out to their accounting systems every day, and we are building a small reconciliation team to make sure they do. We are hiring Payments Reconciliation Specialists on contract to do the daily work: following written procedures, working in Excel and a few web portals, and getting each file right before it goes out. You report to the Payments Reconciliation Lead. The role is tied to a defined program and is filled through a US staffing partner or an offshore vendor.



RESPONSIBILITIES

•  Chargeback Intake: Pick up each chargeback notice from Operations and log it the same day.

•  Order Lookup: Find each affected order in the Web Store portal. A charged-back order can still show as successful, so work from the notice, not the status.

•  Line-Item Reconstruction: List every item on the order and capture the account or GL code from Inventory, the payment ID, the dollar amount and the sales tax, in the same layout as the district's settlement file.

•  Fix File: Build the correction file, broken into the right accounting lines with sales tax, and format it to the district's ERP import (Munis, for example).

•  Settlement Tie-Out: Reconcile the orders and the fix-file detail back to the single aggregated chargeback deduction on the settlement statement. It has to match to the cent.

•  Related Notices: Prepare the daily file of delayed or unfunded transactions, and of disputes and NSF returns, for each of your clients.

•  Quality Check: Run the runbook checklist, then hand your work to the Lead for review. Nothing goes out without a second set of eyes until the Lead lifts that rule for you.

•  Delivery: After review, send the file to the client's Customer Success Manager, who passes it to the district. You never contact a district directly.

•  Escalation: Raise it with the Lead when a SKU has no account code or two of them, when you cannot find an order, when a chargeback is partial, when anything does not tie, when a tax question comes up, or when a runbook step fails or does not cover the request. Never change a template or skip a check on your own.

•  Automation Input: Keep a running note of what is slow or awkward. You will be asked what should be automated.



QUALIFICATIONS AND SKILLS

•  2+ years of hands-on work in cash application, accounts receivable or payable, bank reconciliation, merchant services or payment processor operations, or bookkeeping for a business with card sales.

•  Experience tying detail to a total: many items to one deposit, statement line or batch, and working the differences rather than just flagging them.

•  Excel: XLOOKUP or VLOOKUP, SUMIFS, pivot tables, text-to-columns, saving a clean CSV.

•  Ability to follow a written procedure exactly, and to say so when a step does not work.

•  Accuracy under a daily deadline, and the habit of keeping a log without being asked.

•  Clear written English, for short notes that go to districts under the Lead's name.

•  Chargebacks, disputes or NSF returns from the merchant side are a plus.

•  An ERP import or export (Munis, Skyward, QuickBooks, NetSuite) is a plus.

•  A payment processor portal or settlement statement is a plus.

•  School district, municipal or nonprofit finance is a plus.

•  Required: an accounting degree, a CPA, coding, or any product or engineering background.

**Lead Operations & Data QA Specialist – US Small Business Lending – Full-Time, Long-Term**



**Pay:** $800–$1,200 per month, based on experience. **Hours:** must overlap US Eastern business hours. The daily report is due by 8:30am ET, Monday to Friday. **Location:** Philippines preferred. **Start:** Monday, November 23.



**About 
.** We help US small businesses get funding through a panel of 25 to 40 funders. We buy and generate leads across several channels, and every dollar has to be tracked to funded deals.



**The role.** You keep our lead pipeline clean and our numbers honest. You report to our Head of Borrower Acquisition. Every lead that enters our CRM goes through you, and every morning you report which channels produce funded deals at an acceptable cost.



**What you will do**



- **Feed inserts.** Load lead feeds into the CRM by API, webhook or CSV. Map the fields and fix failed inserts the same day.

- **Dedupe.** Before anyone works a new record, match it against the CRM and the suppression list using phone,
, business name, EIN and address.

- **List scrubbing.** Remove invalid, disconnected and suppressed records, and keep the suppression list current.

- **Aged records.** An aged record goes back into the CRM only after a documented re-permission event. There are no exceptions.

- **Attribution.** Run dynamic number insertion (DNI) and call tracking so every call and form fill is tied to its source, campaign and cost. Check it daily.

- **Daily reporting.** By 8:30am ET, publish closing leads, approval rate and cost per funded account by channel and vendor.

- **Alerts.** If a channel runs above the blended cost-per-funded ceiling three days in a row, flag it that morning.



**Must have**



- 2+ years in lead operations, marketing operations, CRM administration or data QA for a US performance-marketing, lending or insurance business.

- Advanced Google Sheets or Excel, including XLOOKUP or VLOOKUP, pivot tables, QUERY and conditional formulas, plus comfort with large CSV files.

- CRM administration experience, for example Salesforce, HubSpot, GoHighLevel or Zoho.

- Familiarity with call tracking and DNI tools such as CallRail, Ringba or Invoca, and with UTM-based attribution.

- Precise written English, and you notice when numbers do not add up.



**How we hire.** There are five steps: screening questions, a 20-minute video screen, a paid 2-hour data test, a live final interview with an ID check, and two references. We plan to make an offer by November 19 for a November 23 start.



**No-proxy policy.** The person we interview must be the person who does the work. You may not subcontract or share your account. Breaking this policy ends the contract immediately.



**To apply, answer the screening questions and start your cover letter with the words CLEAN DATA.**

 Required Screening Questions



Please answer all five questions as part of your application.



1. Describe the lead feeds and CRM you managed most recently. Include the daily volume, the sources and the tools.



2. How would you dedupe 5,000 new leads against a CRM of 200,000 records when phone formats and business names don't match exactly?



3. How do you set up and check dynamic number insertion so each call is credited to the right channel?



4. Channel A spent $3,000 and produced 20 funded deals. Channel B spent $1,500 and produced 5. If the ceiling is $200 per funded deal, what do you report?



5. Can you deliver a daily report by 8:30am US Eastern, Monday to Friday, starting Monday, November 23?

title: chart preparation experience in a U.S. healthcare
description:
Read Before Applying, This role is NOT a general virtual assistant or scheduling position.



We are specifically hiring for candidates with direct, hands-on chart preparation experience in a U.S. healthcare setting.



If you have not prepared patient charts prior to visits (including verifying referrals, authorizations, and benefits), please do not apply.







We are seeking an experienced Virtual Medical Assistant with a strong background in pre-visit chart preparation and insurance verification to support a high-volume multispecialty clinic.







This role is heavily focused on ensuring patient charts are fully prepared, verified, and complete prior to visits, including referrals, authorizations, benefits, and documentation. Candidates must have hands-on experience in chart prep workflows within a U.S. healthcare setting.







Required Experience (Applicants without this will not be considered):



Minimum 1–2 years of hands-on chart preparation experience in a U.S. medical practice

Proven experience preparing charts prior to patient intake (not just data entry or scheduling)





Experience verifying:



Referrals and authorizations

Insurance eligibility and benefits

PCP assignment and coordination of benefits

Experience using payer portals such as Availity, UHC, Tricare, Cigna, etc.

Ability to interpret and communicate patient financial responsibility before visits









Core Responsibility: Pre-Visit Chart Preparation (Primary Focus)



Prepare and audit patient charts 24–48 hours prior to appointments

Ensure completeness of:

Demographics

Active insurance

PCP assignment

Referrals & authorizations (auth #, validity, visits, POS)

Identify missing or incorrect documentation and resolve proactively

Communicate gaps to patients and clinic staff before visit date

Document all verification steps with reference numbers and notes

Insurance & Benefits Verification (Supporting Chart Prep)



Verify eligibility and benefits using portals and outbound calls

Calculate and communicate patient responsibility using fee schedules

Flag inactive coverage, COB issues, or auth requirements immediately

Coordination & Patient Communication



Notify patients of missing items, financial responsibility, or delays

Coordinate with PCP offices to obtain referrals

Ensure add-on patients are fully prepped before being seen

title: Real Estate Cold Caller & Appointment Setter
description:
Looking for a remote appointment setter to help me find properties to purchase throughout the U.S. You’ll call owners whose properties may not be listed for sale, introduce yourself on my behalf, and ask whether they’d be open to an unsolicited offer. When an owner is interested, you’ll learn a little about the property and schedule a conversation with me.



I’m looking for someone who enjoys talking with people and follows through on what they say. If an owner tells you, “Call me after my tenant’s lease is up in March,” I want to be confident you’ll make that call in March and remember where the conversation left off.



**What you’ll do**



- Make outbound calls to property owners, explain why you’re calling, and find out whether they’d consider selling.

- Ask natural follow-up questions. Confirm the property address and who makes the selling decision. Learn what the owner is willing to share about occupancy, condition, major repairs, timing, and price expectations. For multifamily properties, details such as unit count, vacancies, and current rents help me evaluate a potential offer.

- Book interested owners directly on my calendar. Make sure they know they’ll be speaking with a potential buyer, confirm the time and best callback number, and send me a short summary before the appointment. I handle pricing, offers, and negotiations.

- Manage each prospect in our CRM. Record the outcome of every conversation, schedule agreed callbacks, confirm upcoming appointments, and reconnect after missed calls. Promptly record and honor requests to stop calling.



**What I’m looking for**



- Experience in outbound calling, appointment setting, or phone-based sales. Experience speaking with U.S. property owners is a plus.

- Clear spoken English, strong listening skills, and the judgment to ask another question or politely end a call.

- Accurate written notes and experience using a CRM and an online calendar.

- Reliable internet, a clear-sounding headset, a quiet place to work, and availability to call during agreed U.S. Central Time hours.



**How to apply**



Send a brief summary of your relevant experience, the calling or CRM tools you’ve used, your availability in U.S. Central Time, and your expected hourly rate in USD.



Please also include a **45–60 second voice recording**. Imagine you’ve just introduced yourself and a property owner replies, *“I hadn’t planned on selling, but I’d listen if the price made sense. What are you offering?”* Respond as you would on a live call. I’d like to hear how you handle the question and what you’d ask next.

title: Short Term Rental Virtual Assistant
description:
Short-Term Rental Virtual Assistant

**Remote · Full-Time  · Time zone coverage: Central, US **



About Us

Cherry Properties manages 20 vacation rental properties in Mississippi, Texas and Las Vegas. We aim to give every guest a warm, smooth, five-star stay. Our team is small and works closely together, and we're looking for an organized, guest-focused Virtual Assistant to help us deliver great hospitality from anywhere in the world.



About the Role

As our Short-Term Rental Virtual Assistant, you'll be the first point of contact for our guests. You'll also keep our daily operations running smoothly. You'll handle guest messages, manage reservations, coordinate cleaners and maintenance vendors, and make sure each property is ready for the next arrival. If you love helping people and staying organized, you'll do well in this role.



What You'll Do

- **Guest communication:** Respond quickly and warmly to inquiries, booking requests and guest messages on Airbnb, Vrbo, 
 and any other Chanel.

- **Guest experience:** Send check-in instructions, answer questions during stays and resolve issues calmly and professionally.

- **Reservation management:** Keep calendars in sync and handle booking changes, cancellations and special requests.

- **Turnover coordination:** Schedule cleaners, review cleaning photos and checklists, and track supply inventory.

- **Maintenance coordination:** Log issues, dispatch vendors and follow up until each job is done.

- **Reviews:** Ask guests for reviews, write thoughtful responses and review guests.

- **Admin support:** Update listings, keep records and reports current, and help improve our processes.



 What We're Looking For

- At least 1 year of experience in short-term rentals, hospitality or customer service (please do not apply if you don't have Short term rental experience)

- Excellent written English with a friendly, professional tone

- Strong organization and attention to detail

- The ability to stay calm and solve problems under pressure

- Comfort with technology. Experience with tools like [Hostaway / Guesty / Hospitable], Google Workspace and Slack is a plus.

- A reliable internet connection and a quiet workspace

- Availability during [8:00 am - 9:00 pm], with flexibility for occasional evenings and weekends



Bonus Points

- Experience with Airbnb or Vrbo hosting

- Familiarity with dynamic pricing tools such as PriceLabs or Wheelhouse

- Basic bookkeeping or Canva skills

- Fluency in a second language



What We Offer

- 100% remote work

- [Pay range, $4.5 to $5.5 per hour]

- Performance bonuses

- Paid training and clear written procedures (SOPs)

- Room to grow into a senior operations or team lead role as we expand

- A supportive, appreciative team



How to Apply

Send your resume and a short cover message to 
 with the subject line **"STR Virtual Assistant - [Your Name]**. In your message, please include:

1. Your experience with short-term rentals or hospitality

2. Your availability and time zone

3. How you would respond to this message from a guest: *"We just arrived and the door code isn't working. It's raining and we have kids with us!"*

4. A short video of your self introduction



*We review applications on a rolling basis. Qualified candidates will be invited to a short interview and a paid trial task.*

title: Cash Buyer Cold Caller (Real Estate Wholesaling) – Remote
description:
Pay: Competitive base plus performance bonuses and deal commissions



Schedule: 40 hrs/weekly. Hours must overlap with U.S. business hours, with flexibility within that.



About Us

We’re a U.S.-based real estate investment company specialising in direct-to-agent wholesaling. We’re growing fast and need a confident cold caller who can find active cash buyers and get our deals in front of them. This is the start of a long-term role for the right person. 



What You’ll Do

1. Cold call and text investors: Reach out to active cash buyers every day, learn what they want to buy, and introduce our deals.

2. Build the buyers list: Add every buyer to GoHighLevel with their criteria, target areas, price range, and proof of funds status.

3. Pitch our deals: Match each property to the right buyers, send deal details, and follow up until we have offers.

4. Qualify buyers: Screen for serious buyers and pass hot leads along for negotiation.

5. Track your numbers: Log calls, new buyers, and offers, and make sure every lead has a clear next step.



What You Bring

1. Proven experience in real estate wholesaling or cash buyer outreach (required)

2. Clear, confident spoken English and a professional phone presence

3. Comfort making a high volume of calls and texts

4. CRM experience (GoHighLevel preferred)

5. Organised, detail-orientated, and self-managed



What’s in it for you?

1. Long-term role with real growth potential

2. Uncapped upside through bonuses and commissions on closed deals

3. A direct line to the decision-maker and a chance to shape the acquisitions process



How to Apply

1. Send us a message with:

2. A short summary of your real estate experience (markets worked, deals sold, buyer lists built, call volume if you know it)

3. CRM tools you’ve used, especially GoHighLevel

4. Your available hours and time zone

Applications without a voice recording will not be reviewed.

title: HIGHLY SKILLED AI VIDEO EDITOR – DRAMA STYLE META ADS
description:

We're looking for a highly skilled AI Video Editor specialising in ultra-realistic, drama-style Meta ads to join our growing e-commerce creative team.



This isn't a standard video editing position.



We need someone who can produce highly realistic, story-driven video ads featuring believable characters, natural dialogue, dramatic situations and strong emotional storytelling.



Our goal is to create ads that feel like genuine real-life situations or scenes from a drama series rather than traditional advertisements.



Ultra-realistic AI video generation is an absolute requirement. The finished content should look and feel as close to real filmed footage as possible.



We're looking for someone who understands both storytelling and performance marketing and can turn creative concepts into engaging, high-converting Meta ads.



What You'll Be Creating



Ultra-realistic AI-generated drama ads for DTC e-commerce brands



Story-driven advertisements featuring realistic characters and conversations



Emotionally engaging scenes with strong hooks, tension and storytelling



Cinematic-style videos designed specifically for
 and Instagram



Multiple hook variations for creative testing



High-quality direct-response ads designed to capture attention and drive conversions



These aren't basic slideshow ads, generic UGC videos or simple AI clips stitched together.



We need someone capable of producing complete, believable stories that genuinely hold people's attention.



What We're Looking For



1. Advanced AI Video Generation Skills



You must have advanced experience with AI video generation tools such as:



Google Veo



Kling AI



Higgsfield



Runway



ElevenLabs



HeyGen



Other advanced AI video and audio generation tools



We're not looking for someone who's just started experimenting with AI.



You should already know how to generate realistic scenes, control character movements, create natural dialogue and maintain visual consistency throughout an entire video.



2. Ultra-Realistic AI Is a MUST



This is one of our biggest requirements.



Your AI-generated content must have:



Realistic facial expressions and natural human movements



Accurate, believable lip-syncing



Natural-sounding dialogue and voiceovers



Consistent characters across multiple scenes



Realistic environments, lighting and camera movements



Smooth scene transitions and continuity



No obvious AI glitches, unnatural movements or robotic voices



If your AI-generated videos clearly look artificial, this position won't be the right fit.



3. Strong Storytelling and Drama Editing



We need someone who understands how to make people want to keep watching.



You should be able to:



Build tension and curiosity throughout a video



Create powerful hooks within the first few seconds



Edit natural, believable conversations between characters



Use pacing, music and sound effects to strengthen emotional impact



Create dramatic moments that keep viewers engaged



Turn creative briefs and scripts into compelling visual stories



4. Understanding of Meta Ads



Experience editing
 and Instagram ads is highly preferred.



You should understand:



Direct-response advertising



Hook retention and viewer engagement



Creative testing and hook variations



How to structure videos for conversions



Why some creatives perform better than others



We don't just want videos that look good. We want videos that perform.



Your Responsibilities



Produce a minimum of 3–4 high-quality video ad concepts per day, including revisions



Generate ultra-realistic AI scenes using your own tools



Edit complete videos with professional pacing, sound design and captions



Follow creative briefs, scripts and references accurately



Maintain character and visual consistency across scenes



Produce multiple hook variations when required



Complete revisions quickly without compromising quality



Communicate clearly with the creative team



Deliver work consistently and meet agreed deadlines



Daily Output Requirement



You must be capable of consistently delivering 3–4 completed video ad concepts per working day, including revisions.



We operate in a fast-paced creative testing environment, so speed, efficiency and quality are equally important.



We're looking for someone who can maintain a high standard of work while handling a consistent daily workload.



Salary, Bonuses & Growth Opportunities



Base Salary: $1,500 USD per month



On top of your monthly salary, we offer performance-based bonuses.



Winning Ad Bonuses – Up to $1,000 per winning ad

If your ads perform well and become winning creatives, you'll have the opportunity to earn significant bonuses on top of your base salary, subject to our winning-ad criteria.

Advanced video editing skills

title: Experienced Travel Planner — Group Itineraries & Proposals
description:
Vohana LLC is a B2B travel company that works with travel industry partners to plan trips for their clients, including medium to large groups. We’re looking for an experienced travel planner to turn partner briefs into realistic itineraries and polished proposals. You’ll also manage our Fora account once it’s set up, participate in the community, and help identify new leads for Vohana.



What you’ll do



- Build day-by-day itineraries around each group’s size, interests, dates, budget, and preferred pace.

- Research hotels, transportation, tours, and activities. Verify pricing, availability, group capacity, and travel times.

- Prepare proposals that clearly explain the itinerary, pricing, and what’s included. Review details for accuracy and revise drafts based on feedback from our team and travel partners.

- Manage Vohana’s Fora account. Participate regularly in community discussions, build relationships with other members, and look for opportunities where Vohana can help with group travel. Track promising leads and coordinate follow-up with our team.



Experience and skills



Prior professional travel planning experience is required.** You should have built multi-day itineraries and prepared travel proposals or quotes for clients. Experience working with travel advisors, agencies, or tour operators and planning trips for medium to large groups is especially valuable.



Itinerary planning and logistics.- Build realistic schedules that account for group transfers, activity timing, and how long it takes to move a group between stops.



Travel research and budgeting.- Compare options, verify costs and capacity, and recommend choices that fit the group’s needs and budget.



Proposal writing.- Present the itinerary, pricing, and inclusions clearly so our partners can review and share the proposal with their clients.



Our team uses -Travefy, Claude, ChatGPT, Airtable, Google Workspace (including Google Chat), and GoHighLevel (GHL)**. Familiarity with any of these tools is a plus, and experience with similar platforms is welcome. Experience with Fora, advisor communities, or relationship-based lead generation is also welcome.



- Air ticketing experience is a plus-  and could be useful as we expand our services.



## How to apply



Send your résumé or a short introduction and list your relevant travel planning experience. For each role or project you highlight, include the company, agency, or freelance practice you worked with, the dates, the destinations and typical group sizes you handled, and the tools you used. If you have experience with Fora, sourcing leads through an advisor community, or air ticketing, briefly describe what you personally handled.



Please answer these three questions using real projects. You may use the same trip for all three answers if it fits.



1. **What’s one multi-day group itinerary you helped build?** Include the destination, number of travelers, number of days, who you prepared it for, and which parts you personally planned or wrote.

2. **What’s one logistical challenge you handled on a group trip?** Describe the issue, such as hotel capacity, coach transfers, or activity limits, and explain what you personally changed in the itinerary and why.

3. **What did you personally contribute to a group travel proposal or quote?** Include the group size, who received the proposal, which parts you wrote or priced, and how you checked that the pricing and inclusions matched the itinerary.



If you have an itinerary or proposal sample you’re allowed to share, please remove client details before including it.

title: Patient Accounts Reconciliation Specialist (PRN Contractor)
description:
The Purpose of Your Role   



The primary objective of this project is to research, identify, and accurately post unallocated payments, credits, and undistributed funds within our patient accounting system. You will investigate historical transactions, resolve variances, and ensure that patient accounts reflect precise, up-to-date financial balances in compliance with company policies and healthcare regulations. 





The Company You’ll Join 



OCD Anxiety Centers is the nation’s largest provider of IOP services for individuals dealing with OCD, Anxiety, and Trauma. As the leading provider, our clinical outcomes are second to none. You will join a winning team that is committed to evidence-based treatment and long-term results. We are passionate about bringing help and hope to some of the most underserved clinical populations. We strive to change the lives of individuals and their families suffering from unrelenting anxiety, disturbing and terrifying thoughts, uncontrollable worry, exhausting behaviors and rituals, and avoidance that keeps them from living their lives. We are an evidence-based practice, which means we do what works, stay current with scientific research, and regularly attend international training to keep us at our very best. Our values are as follows:  



Growth 

Proactivity 

Positivity 

Results Driven 





Our Investment in You 

A competitive base salary starting at $9 to $11 per hour 





Responsibilities 



Research Unallocated Monies: Audit patient accounts to identify the root cause of unallocated payments,  

 overpayments, unidentified clearinghouse credits, and misapplied funds. 



Accurate Payment Posting: Post, adjust, and reallocate payments to correct patient encounters or line items in accordance with explanation of benefits (EOBs), remittances, and patient receipts. 



Account Reconciliation: Balance and reconcile daily or batch posting workflows against bank deposits and financial system logs. 



Error Resolution: Identify systemic trends causing unallocated balances (e.g., clearinghouse issues, front-desk collection errors) and report findings to management. 



Compliance Management: Ensure all adjustments, refunds, or balance transfers strictly adhere to HIPAA guidelines, internal control procedures, and healthcare billing compliance standards. 



Adheres to all company policies and procedures 



Other duties as assigned 



 



Qualifications 



Experience: Minimum of 2–3 years of experience in healthcare medical billing, patient accounts receivable, or healthcare payment posting. 



Technical Skills: High proficiency with Electronic Health Record (EHR) and practice management software (e.g., Epic, Cerner, eClinicalWorks, or similar billing platforms). Advanced Excel skills (VLOOKUPs, pivot tables) are highly preferred. 



Knowledge Base: Strong understanding of medical billing terminology, EOB interpretation, coordination of benefits (COB), and healthcare accounting practices. 



Attributes: Exceptional analytical, problem-solving, and auditing skills; ability to work independently with minimal supervision. 



 



Project Timeline & Performance KPIs 



Should this contract extend, performance will be evaluated against the following milestones to measure efficiency, speed, and accuracy: 



 



30-Day KPIs (Onboarding & Accuracy Baseline) 



 Complete standard system training and demonstrate proficiency in navigating the practice management ledger. 



 Establish a steady daily review cadence, auditing a minimum of 35-40 unallocated transactions per day. 



 Maintain a posting and reconciliation accuracy rate of 99% or higher on all audited accounts. 



 



60-Day KPIs (Volume Acceleration & Error Reduction) 



 Increase daily workflow throughput to audit and resolve a minimum of 45–50 unallocated transactions per day. 



 Achieve a posting accuracy rate of 99% or higher with minimal supervision or need for posting reversals. 



 Successfully identify, categorize, and document at least two major root causes of systemic unallocated funds to assist the permanent team in preventative measures. 





Note: This is a PRN (as-needed) position, meaning there is no fixed work schedule or guaranteed number of hours.

title: Business Funding Specialist (Recent 2025-2026 Experience Required) | Client Zoom Applications
description:
Hoodrich Credit is hiring an EXPERIENCED Business Funding Specialist. You will review client files, build a funding plan, and guide U.S. clients through their applications on live Zoom calls. This is not an entry-level role. We only want people who are doing business funding right now and know which banks and lenders are approving today.



RECENT EXPERIENCE IS REQUIRED

- You have personally helped U.S. clients get business funding within the last 6 months.

- You know the current banks, credit unions and card issuers that are approving business credit cards and lines of credit right now, plus their current inquiry sensitivity, bureau pulls and approval patterns.

- You can explain what changed in the last year and which lenders no longer work.

- Applicants without recent, hands-on funding results will not be considered.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Pick up new client assignments in Slack and GoHighLevel and confirm intake info and documents are complete.

- Review authorized credit reports, business details, existing banking relationships and documents.

- Build a funding application plan (which lenders, what order, which bureaus) before every client session.

- Lead screen-shared Zoom sessions while clients complete and submit their own applications on their own devices.

- Make sure every application uses accurate, truthful information supported by the client's records.

- Record results, approval amounts, pending decisions and follow-ups in the CRM.

- Follow up on pending decisions and reconsideration calls, and escalate issues fast.

- Generate invoices per the signed agreement and keep pipeline stages current.

- Post a daily activity report in Slack.



REQUIREMENTS

- Excellent spoken and written English and confidence leading live video calls with U.S. clients.

- Proven, recent results in business funding (cards, lines of credit, term loans).

- Strong credit report analysis.

- GoHighLevel, Slack, Zoom and credit-monitoring tools.

- Full-time availability overlapping U.S. business hours (Eastern time).

- Reliable internet with a backup, and a quiet call setup.



Clients complete and submit their own applications. Approvals and amounts are never guaranteed.



COMMISSION

On top of base pay, you earn 0.25% of the funding secured for each client you help get funded (e.g. $10,000 funded = $25 extra).



HOW TO APPLY (applications that skip these will not be reviewed)

1. Subject line: FUNDING SPECIALIST - [Your Full Name]

2. Your resume and how long you have been doing business funding, including your most recent client funded (month/year).

3. List 5 banks or lenders you have gotten clients approved with in the last 6 months, and which bureau each one pulled.

4. Two anonymized recent results (credit profile summary, lenders used, total approved). No private client data.

5. How you prepare for a session and what you do when a client's documents don't match.

6. Your availability, time zone and start date.

title: Experienced DTC Meta Ai Video Editor (ULTRA REALISTIC)
description:
QUICK SUMMARY

Daily Output: At least 3 concepts per day (averaging 2 minutes each), including revisions.



Focus: Ultra-high-level direct-response product ads leveraging advanced AI video generation, hyper-realistic AI UGC, and intricate product integration.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We are looking for an elite, world-class AI Video Editor & Creative Specialist who operates at the absolute cutting edge of artificial intelligence and direct-response advertising.



This role is not for basic prompt-and-pray creators. We need someone who can execute the most intricate, complex AI workflows in the industry—from generating hyper-realistic AI UGC showing products being actively applied, worn, or interacted with, to seamlessly blending synthetic elements into live-action footage so they are entirely indistinguishable from reality.



You understand direct-response psychology, retention editing, pacing, and the nuances of high-converting Meta and TikTok ad creatives. Speed is critical, but realism, physical accuracy, and conversion quality are non-negotiable.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

High-Volume Concept Production: Deliver at least 3 distinct, fully polished ad concepts daily (approx. 2 minutes per video), including all revisions and iterations based on performance feedback.



Ultra-Realistic AI UGC & Product Interaction: Create flawless AI characters and UGC creators that look, move, and speak with human realism. Execute complex interactions such as applying skincare/products, unboxing, wearing items, and handling objects with zero physical artifacts.



Advanced AI Video & B-Roll Generation: Utilize state-of-the-art video models (Runway Gen-3/4, Kling, Luma) to produce cinematic, clean-lighting, texturally accurate b-roll and scene extensions that integrate invisibly into real-world footage.



Character, Voice, & Lip-Sync Mastery: Direct and manage hyper-realistic AI talking heads, precise lip-syncing, emotional delivery, and nuanced accent distinction (British/American).



End-to-End Post-Production: Handle scripting support, prompt engineering, compositing, upscaling (Topaz), sound design, colour grading, pacing, and final export delivery across Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, or CapCut Desktop.



REQUIRED TECHNICAL SKIC-K (YOUR STACK)

You must already be a power user across most of the following tools:



AI Video: Runway Gen-3 / Gen-4, Kling, Luma Dream Machine, LTX Studio, or equivalent advanced motion models.



Voice / Character: HeyGen, ElevenLabs, D-ID, or custom pipeline equivalents.



Image Generation: Midjourney v6+, Leonardo.ai, Stable Diffusion (ControlNet/IP-Adapter for product consistency).



Editing Suite: Adobe Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, or CapCut Desktop.



Enhancement: Topaz Video AI.



REQUIREMENTS & STANDARDS

Obsessive Attention to Detail: You must instantly spot and fix distorted fingers, floating objects, unnatural lighting, warping textures, awkward lip-syncing, or dead emotion. If it looks "AI-generated," it doesn't ship.



Direct-Response Fluency: Deep understanding of hooks, visual retention triggers, emotional arcs, and what makes high-ticket or DTC products convert on paid social.



Exceptional Speed & Output: Proven ability to maintain a blistering daily pace (3+ concepts/day at 2 minutes each) without sacrificing technical or visual quality.



Audio & Accent Awareness: Flawless English comprehension with the ability to direct and refine voice deliveries, pacing, and regional accents (UK/US).



COMPENSATION & BONUSES

Base Salary: $1,500 per month



Performance Bonuses:



$200 Bonus: Any winning ad spending over $200/day at a 1.8+ ROAS.



$1,000 Bonus: Any winning ad spending $1,000/day at a 2.0+ ROAS.



HOW TO APPLY

Please provide:



A portfolio or folder showcasing your best AI-assisted video work, product ad creatives, and complex AI UGC.



Direct examples of intricate product interaction/application generated via AI.



A list of the AI tools and versions you currently use or pay for regularly.



Application Requirement:

To prove you have strong attention to detail, start your application or cover letter with the secret word: NEURAL
